step_actions.label: Adjust a number
step_actions.description: Takes from or adds to a number field on a loaded EntityEntry and saves it through Entries::Save, reloading the stored row under a lock so concurrent submits cannot both spend the same stock. Use this for seats left, inventory, or a running total; use set_record_fields to assign without saving, or update_model to persist other attributes. Reads modelVariable, field, direction, and amount. Writes the new number to resultVar. Refuses the run (adjust_number.below_minimum / above_maximum) when the result would pass minimum or maximum, showing message on errorField; other write errors fail as adjust_number.failed.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the loaded EntityEntry to change, such as product after referenced_record. Not a person id or a hash.

config_fields.name: field
config_fields.description: Slug of the number attribute to change, such as stock or seats_left. Must be a writable field of that record's entity.

config_fields.name: direction
config_fields.description: subtract takes amount away (booked seats, sold stock). add increases the stored number (returning stock, adding points).

config_fields.name: amount
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for how much to take or add, such as ctx[:model].quantity. Must evaluate to an integer or decimal.

config_fields.name: minimum
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the lowest allowed result, commonly 0. Omit for no floor. A result below this refuses the submit and writes nothing.

config_fields.name: maximum
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the highest allowed result, such as ctx[:product].capacity. Omit for no ceiling. A result above this refuses the submit.

config_fields.name: message
config_fields.description: Localized refusal copy. Placeholder available is how much can still be taken or added. When blank, the default below_minimum / above_maximum message is used.

config_fields.name: errorField
config_fields.description: Form field slug the refusal is shown on, such as quantity (the amount the visitor typed), not the stock field being changed.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the new stored number after a successful save, such as adjusted_value.

step_actions.label: Aggregate Query
step_actions.description: Computes sum, average, min, max, or count over tenant-scoped rows of the bound entity, or of another entity named in entity (for example invoice totals). Use count_records for a plain count and query_models to list rows. Writes a scalar or keyed hash to resultVar. groupByFields groups by attribute slugs; having is an allowlisted aggregate comparison such as SUM(amount) > 100. Fails when entity is not reachable or having is unsafe.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Entity to aggregate, by name or id (Invoice). Leave blank to use the page's bound entity. Must be reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: aggregations
config_fields.description: Attribute slug to operation pairs (amount => sum, qty => count). Operations: sum, avg, min, max, count. When set, aggregateFunction and aggregateField are ignored.

config_fields.name: aggregateFunction
config_fields.description: Function used when aggregations is empty. sum (default) totals aggregateField; average/minimum/maximum/count use the matching SQL aggregate.

config_fields.name: aggregateField
config_fields.description: Attribute slug to aggregate when aggregations is empty (amount). Default amount. Must be a safe identifier.

config_fields.name: groupByFields
config_fields.description: Attribute slugs to group by (status, category). Leave empty for a single scalar. Grouped results are typically a hash of group value => metric.

config_fields.name: having
config_fields.description: Allowlisted HAVING comparison applied after grouping, for example SUM(amount) > 100 or COUNT(*) > 1. Rejected unless it matches that shape. Requires groupByFields.

config_fields.name: resultFormat
config_fields.description: scalar (default) writes one number (or a grouped hash of group => value). hash writes keyed metrics such as sum_amount. Scalar requires at most one aggregation pair.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Filter rows before aggregating. leftOperand is an attribute slug (status) or row column (created_at, id). rightOperand is a literal (paid) or a ctx path (ctx.model.status).

config_fields.name: recordScope
config_fields.description: all (default) aggregates every tenant row. own aggregates only the signed-in member's rows via People::Ownership. Unsigned runs, and entities no member owns, aggregate none.

config_fields.name: roundTo
config_fields.description: Decimal places to round numeric results to (0-10). Leave blank to keep full precision. Applied to scalars and hash values.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the scalar, grouped hash, or keyed metrics. Default aggregates.

step_actions.label: Batch Operation
step_actions.description: Updates, destroys, or iterates tenant-scoped rows from sourceVariable, intersected with the bound entity (or entity when set). Prefer update_all and destroy_all, which write through Entries.save/destroy so lifecycle and audience still apply. find_each and in_batches run stepBody per record; each_batch yields a relation. Writes the processed count to progressVar. Fails when the source cannot be ANDed with the tenant scope, or when entity is not reachable.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path holding the source relation or collection (items). ANDed with the tenant-scoped entity so another customer's rows cannot be written.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Entity whose rows are batched, by name or id. Leave blank to use the page's bound entity. Must be reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: operationType
config_fields.description: find_each (default) and in_batches yield each record to stepBody. each_batch yields a relation. update_all assigns fieldAssignments through Entries.save. destroy_all deletes through Entries.destroy.

config_fields.name: batchSize
config_fields.description: Records processed per batch (1-10000). Default 1000.

config_fields.name: stepBody
config_fields.description: Ruby run for each record (find_each/in_batches) or batch relation (each_batch). Default saves the record through Entries.save. each_batch defaults to true (count only).

config_fields.name: fieldAssignments
config_fields.description: Attribute slug to Ruby expression pairs written on each matching row (status => "closed"). Required for update_all. Internal columns cannot be assigned.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Extra filters ANDed onto the tenant-scoped source. leftOperand is an attribute slug (status) or row column (id). rightOperand is a literal or a ctx path (ctx.model.status).

config_fields.name: recordScope
config_fields.description: all (default) includes every tenant row. own keeps only the signed-in member's rows via People::Ownership. Unsigned runs, and entities no member owns, process none.

config_fields.name: errorCollection
config_fields.description: When true, a failed row is stored on ctx[:_batch_errors] and the batch continues. Default false fails the step on the first failed write.

config_fields.name: maxRecords
config_fields.description: Stop after this many records (0-100000). 0 (default) means no cap.

config_fields.name: stopOnError
config_fields.description: When true with errorCollection, skip remaining records after the first collected error. Default false. Shown when errorCollection is on.

config_fields.name: progressVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives how many records were processed. Default progress.

step_actions.label: Bulk Import
step_actions.description: Creates or updates tenant-scoped rows of the bound entity (or entity when set) from sourceVariable hashes. uniqueBy attribute slugs find an existing row; onDuplicateKey skip or update. Field mappings rename source columns to entity attributes. Each row is saved through Entries.save so lifecycle and audience still apply. Writes created/updated/skipped/failed counts to resultVar and skipped-row errors to errorsVar. Fails when the list exceeds 1000 rows, a row fails and onRowError is fail, or entity is not reachable.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path holding an array of row hashes (records). At most 1000 rows. Extra columns are ignored unless fieldMappings is set.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Entity to import into, by name or id. Leave blank to use the page's bound entity. Must be reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: onDuplicateKey
config_fields.description: skip (default) leaves an existing uniqueBy match unchanged. update assigns the row and saves through Entries.save. update requires uniqueBy.

config_fields.name: uniqueBy
config_fields.description: Attribute slugs used to find an existing row (email). Empty uniqueBy always creates. Internal columns cannot be used. Required when onDuplicateKey is update.

config_fields.name: fieldMappings
config_fields.description: Source column name to entity attribute slug pairs (addr => email). Leave empty to use hash keys as attribute slugs.

config_fields.name: recordScope
config_fields.description: all (default) matches existing rows across the tenant. own only matches the signed-in member's rows, so an import cannot update someone else's record; on an entity no member owns it matches none.

config_fields.name: batchSize
config_fields.description: Rows committed per batch (1-1000). Default 500. When onRowError is fail, the whole list is one batch so a failure rolls every row back.

config_fields.name: onRowError
config_fields.description: skip (default) records the row error and continues. fail stops, rolls back the import, and moves to the failure track with bulk_import.row_failed.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the counts hash (created, updated, skipped, failed, errors). Default import_result.

config_fields.name: errorsVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives skipped-row errors ({index, message}). Default import_errors. Empty when every row succeeds.

step_actions.label: Child records
step_actions.description: Finds, lists, counts, or creates EntityEntry rows of another entity whose reference field points at a loaded record, such as an order's lines. Use this for records that point at the source, including a link row's own values; use related_record to walk a declared association to the other end of a link, and referenced_record to follow a reference field on the source. Reads entity, optional field, modelVariable, and operation. Writes the rows, one row, the count, or the created row to resultVar. Create always sets the child's reference to the source. Fails as child_records.failed on resolver errors, or child_records.not_found when find onNotFound is fail and nothing matches.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Name of the child entity whose rows point at the source, such as Order line. A numeric entity id is also accepted.

config_fields.name: field
config_fields.description: Slug of the child's reference to the source, such as order. Leave blank when that entity has exactly one such reference; name one when it has several.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the parent record the children point at, such as model or cart. A numeric id is accepted when field names the child's reference.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: list returns rows for a loop (collection = resultVar). find returns the first match. count returns an integer. create writes one child pointing at the source.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Extra filters on the child rows, such as status == Open. Ignored for create. Leave empty to include every child of the source.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Child attributes to set on create, such as quantity => ctx[:line].quantity. The reference to the source is set for you and cannot be redirected. Assign a reference as a record id, such as ctx[:product].id.

config_fields.name: onNotFound
config_fields.description: When find matches nothing: nil stores nil on resultVar and the step succeeds. fail refuses the run as child_records.not_found.

config_fields.name: limit
config_fields.description: Maximum child rows list returns (1-1000, default 100). find and count ignore this.

config_fields.name: orderBy
config_fields.description: Child attribute or column to sort by, such as quantity or id. Blank sorts by id. Used by list and find (first after sort).

config_fields.name: orderDirection
config_fields.description: asc is oldest/lowest first (default). desc is newest/highest first, including when orderBy is blank (then by id).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable for the result: an array (list), one row (find/create), or an integer (count). Use a singular name such as line for find/create.

step_actions.label: Clone record
step_actions.description: Duplicates a loaded EntityEntry (modelVariable, default model) with dup into resultVar (default clone). excludeFields are cleared on the copy; overrides then assign expressions. persist false (default) leaves the copy unsaved for build_contract; persist true saves it through Entries::Save. onMissing fail (default) refuses with record_missing; ignore continues. File and Image fields keep the source's stored files unless excluded. Does not copy associations; use related_record to clone children separately. Fails through clone_model.failed when duplication raises.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the record to copy. Default model. Load it with find_model first; an empty variable follows onMissing.

config_fields.name: excludeFields
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attribute slugs cleared on the copy (set to nil). Example: email. Empty by default. Use this for unique fields you will override.

config_fields.name: overrides
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attributes written onto the copy after excludeFields. Each key is an attribute slug; each value is a Ruby expression such as ctx[:params][:email]. Empty by default.

config_fields.name: persist
config_fields.description: When true, save the copy immediately through Entries::Save. Default false (leave unsaved so build_contract can wrap it). A failed save refuses the step.

config_fields.name: onMissing
config_fields.description: When the source record variable is empty: fail (default) refuses with record_missing; ignore continues without copying.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the copy. Default clone. Distinct from model so the original row stays available.

step_actions.label: Count Records
step_actions.description: Counts tenant-scoped rows of the page's bound entity, or of another entity named in entity (for example this member's Bookings). Use query_models to list rows and aggregate_query to sum or average a field. Writes a count, true/false existence, or grouped counts to resultVar. recordScope own keeps only the signed-in member's rows. Fails when onZero is fail and the count is 0, or when entity is not reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Entity to count, by name or id (Bookings). Leave blank to use the page's bound entity. Must be reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Filter rows before counting. leftOperand is an attribute slug (status, member) or row column (created_at, id). rightOperand is a literal (active) or a ctx path (ctx.model.status, ctx.current_user_id).

config_fields.name: resultAs
config_fields.description: count (default) writes the number of matching rows. exists writes true when at least one row matches. absent writes true when none match.

config_fields.name: recordScope
config_fields.description: all (default) counts every tenant row. own counts only the signed-in member's rows via People::Ownership. Unsigned runs, and entities no member owns, count 0.

config_fields.name: distinct
config_fields.description: When true, count distinct rows (or distinct distinctField values). Shown only when resultAs is count. Default false.

config_fields.name: distinctField
config_fields.description: Attribute slug whose distinct values are counted (email). Shown when distinct is true. Leave blank to count distinct rows.

config_fields.name: groupBy
config_fields.description: Attribute slug to group the count by (status). Writes a hash of value => count. Shown only when resultAs is count. Leave blank for a single number.

config_fields.name: onZero
config_fields.description: zero (default) writes 0 and stays on the success track. fail moves to the failure track with count_records.zero when no rows match. Shown only when resultAs is count.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the count, grouped hash, or boolean. Default count.

step_actions.label: Destroy record
step_actions.description: Deletes or archives a loaded EntityEntry (modelVariable, default model). mode delete (default) destroys the row through Entries.destroy; archive stamps archiveField with the current time and optionally archivedByField with ctx[:current_user_id], then saves. onMissing fail (default) refuses with record_missing; ignore continues. Use find_model first to load the row. This does not cascade to other entities. Prefer archive when the business must keep history; delete removes the tenant row permanently.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the record to destroy or archive. Default model. Load it with find_model (or related_record) first.

config_fields.name: mode
config_fields.description: delete (default) permanently removes the tenant row. archive keeps the row and writes the current time to archiveField (and optionally the current user id to archivedByField).

config_fields.name: archiveField
config_fields.description: Date-time attribute set to Time.current when mode is archive. Example: archived_at. Required for archive.

config_fields.name: archivedByField
config_fields.description: Optional attribute set to ctx[:current_user_id] when mode is archive. Example: archived_by. Leave blank to stamp only the time.

config_fields.name: onMissing
config_fields.description: When the record variable is empty: fail (default) refuses with record_missing; ignore continues without writing.

step_actions.label: Find record
step_actions.description: Loads one bound-entity row into resultVar (default model) by id (idSource), by one attribute (findField and findValue), or as the signed-in member's person record (current_person, from ctx[:current_person_ids], never params). Optionally sets foundVar to whether a row existed, and lock takes a FOR UPDATE lock for a later write in this submit. onNotFound fail (default) refuses with record_not_found or notFoundMessage; nil leaves the variable empty and continues; new builds an unsaved tenant row. Use related_record or referenced_record for another entity, upsert_model to find-or-create, and load_current_user for the User.

config_fields.name: findBy
config_fields.description: How to look the row up. id uses idSource (default params.id). attribute matches findField to findValue. current_person loads the signed-in member's linked person entry and ignores posted ids.

config_fields.name: idSource
config_fields.description: Context path of the id to look up when findBy is id. Default params.id (the page record's id on update). Example: params.order_id.

config_fields.name: findField
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attribute slug to match when findBy is attribute. Example: email. Combined with findValue as an equality lookup.

config_fields.name: findValue
config_fields.description: Context path of the value to match when findBy is attribute. Example: params.email. Compared with equality against findField.

config_fields.name: onNotFound
config_fields.description: When no row matches: fail refuses the submit with record_not_found (or notFoundMessage); nil stores nothing and continues so a Decision can branch on foundVar; new builds an unsaved tenant-scoped row (and copies the lookup attribute when findBy is attribute).

config_fields.name: notFoundMessage
config_fields.description: Optional localized submitter message used instead of the default record_not_found text when onNotFound is fail. Requires an en value.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the loaded row, or the new unsaved row when onNotFound is new. Default model.

config_fields.name: foundVar
config_fields.description: Optional boolean variable set before onNotFound runs: true when a matching row existed, false when it did not. Leave blank to skip.

config_fields.name: lock
config_fields.description: When true, the lookup uses SELECT FOR UPDATE so a later update_model or adjust_number in this submit sees a consistent row. Default false. Only holds for the page-submit transaction.

step_actions.label: Load current user
step_actions.description: Loads the signed-in user for this customer as a frozen read-only hash. Use this to branch on role or to address a notification; do not treat id as a person or record id (that mapping is person_entries). Writes resultVar (default current_user) to a hash with string keys id, email, name, role, and person_entries (person entity id to that user's own record id). When required is true (default), fails as load_current_user.not_signed_in if no signed-in user belongs to this tenant. When required is false, stores nil and the step still succeeds.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the frozen user hash. Read keys with ctx[:current_user]["email"], ["name"], ["role"], ["id"], or ["person_entries"].

config_fields.name: required
config_fields.description: When true (default), the step fails as load_current_user.not_signed_in if ctx[:current_user_id] is missing or the user is not in this tenant. When false, resultVar is nil and the step succeeds.

step_actions.label: New record
step_actions.description: Creates an unsaved EntityEntry of the page's bound entity and stores it in resultVar (default model). Use this on create pages before build_contract when ctx[:model] is not already the page record, or to start another new row of the same entity. Assignments set attributes from Ruby expressions before any save. It does not persist; follow with build_contract, validate_contract and save_model (or update_model) to write. Prefer find_model when the row should already exist, and upsert_model to find-or-create in one step.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the new unsaved record. Default model, which is also the page record seeded on submit.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attributes to set on the new row before save. Each key is an attribute slug; each value is a Ruby expression such as ctx[:params][:email]. Empty by default. Unknown slugs fail at runtime.

step_actions.label: Sequence number
step_actions.description: Allocates the next tenant-scoped sequence number for a named counter, formatted with prefix, zero-padding, optional date segment, and suffix (for example ORD-2026-000001). Use this after save_model for a reference number the visitor does not type; use adjust_number to change a stored quantity on a record. resetEvery starts a new counter per calendar period; dateSegment only inserts a display date and does not reset the counter. Allocation runs inside the submit transaction, so a refused run does not consume a number; concurrent submits still receive distinct values. Writes the formatted string to resultVar. Fails as next_sequence_number.failed when customer_id or name is missing.

config_fields.name: sequenceName
config_fields.description: Identifier of this customer's counter, such as order or invoice. Same name, same period bucket, one sequence. Must be a Ruby identifier (letters, digits, underscore).

config_fields.name: prefix
config_fields.description: Text prepended to the formatted number, such as INV- or ORD-. May be blank.

config_fields.name: suffix
config_fields.description: Text appended after the padded number, such as -CN. May be blank.

config_fields.name: padding
config_fields.description: Zero-pad width of the numeric part (1-12, default 6). 6 yields 000001.

config_fields.name: startAt
config_fields.description: First number issued for a new period bucket (1-1000000, default 1). Applied as startAt + (count-1)*step.

config_fields.name: step
config_fields.description: Amount added after each issue (1-1000, default 1). Use 5 to get 100, 105, 110 when startAt is 100.

config_fields.name: resetEvery
config_fields.description: When a new counter starts for this name: never is one running counter. year/month/day/week/quarter each use a fresh last_value for that calendar bucket (Time.zone).

config_fields.name: dateSegment
config_fields.description: Optional date inserted between prefix and the padded number: none, year (2026), year_month (2026-11), or date (2026-11-23). Display only; it does not reset the counter.

config_fields.name: separator
config_fields.description: Separator between the date segment and the padded number, default -. Ignored when dateSegment is none.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the formatted string, such as sequence_number. Assign it onto the record with update_model.

step_actions.label: Query Models
step_actions.description: Lists tenant-scoped rows of the page's bound entity, or of another entity named in entity (for example Bookings). Use find_model for a single row, count_records for a count, and aggregate_query for sum/avg/min/max. Conditions filter by attribute slug on the left and a literal or ctx path on the right. Writes matching records or plucked values to resultVar and optional page metadata to paginationVar. Fails when onEmpty is fail and nothing matches, or when entity is not reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: entity
config_fields.description: Entity to query, by name or id (Bookings). Leave blank to use the page's bound entity. Must be reachable from this customer.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Filter rows. leftOperand is an attribute slug on the queried entity (status, email) or a row column (created_at, id), never a ctx path. rightOperand is a literal (active) or a ctx path (ctx.model.status, ctx.current_user_id) resolved at run time.

config_fields.name: select
config_fields.description: Attribute slugs to return. Required when returns is values (email). When returns is records, a non-empty list projects each row to those slugs.

config_fields.name: returns
config_fields.description: records (default) writes EntityEntry rows, or projected hashes when select is set. values plucks select slugs as scalars (one slug) or arrays (several).

config_fields.name: recordScope
config_fields.description: all (default) includes every tenant row of the entity. own keeps only the signed-in member's rows via People::Ownership (person, owned, or nested). Unsigned runs, and entities no member owns, see none.

config_fields.name: pageVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path holding the 1-based page number (page, or params.page). Used only when pageSize is set. Defaults to page.

config_fields.name: pageSize
config_fields.description: Rows per page (1-200). Leave blank to skip pagination. When set, writes page metadata to paginationVar.

config_fields.name: limit
config_fields.description: Maximum rows to return when pageSize is blank (1-1000). Ignored when paginating.

config_fields.name: orderBy
config_fields.description: Attribute slug (email, status) or row column (created_at, updated_at, id) to sort by. Leave blank for unordered results. Unsafe names are rejected.

config_fields.name: orderDirection
config_fields.description: Primary sort direction. asc (default) is A-Z / oldest first; desc is Z-A / newest first. Used only when orderBy is set.

config_fields.name: distinct
config_fields.description: When true, drop duplicate rows after select and order. Default false.

config_fields.name: onEmpty
config_fields.description: empty (default) writes an empty list and stays on the success track. fail moves to the failure track with query_models.empty when no rows match.

config_fields.name: offset
config_fields.description: Rows to skip before limit or the current page (0-100000). Added on top of pagination. Default 0.

config_fields.name: thenOrderBy
config_fields.description: Secondary sort attribute slug or column (email) used when the primary sort ties. Same safety rule as orderBy.

config_fields.name: thenOrderDirection
config_fields.description: Secondary sort direction. asc (default) or desc. Used only when thenOrderBy is set.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the records, projected hashes, or plucked values. Default models.

config_fields.name: paginationVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives page metadata (total_count, page, per_page, total_pages, has_next) when pageSize is set. Default pagination.

step_actions.label: Referenced record
step_actions.description: Loads, or updates and saves, the EntityEntry a reference field on a loaded record points at, such as a line's product or a row's parent order. Use child_records when other records point at this one, related_record to walk a many-to-many association, and adjust_number to change a number on the referenced row under a concurrency lock. Reads modelVariable, field, and operation. Writes the referenced row to resultVar. Fails as referenced_record.not_found when the field is blank or the row is gone and onNotFound is fail, or referenced_record.failed on a non-reference field or save error. Update with onNotFound nil skips assignments when nothing is referenced.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the record that holds the reference, such as model (the submitted line) or cart. Must be a loaded EntityEntry.

config_fields.name: field
config_fields.description: Slug of the reference field on that record, such as product or order. Must be an EntityReference or a choice list filled from another entity's records.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: find loads the referenced row and stops. update then assigns assignments and saves that row through Entries::Save.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Referenced-entity attributes to set on update, such as status => "reserved". Keys belong to the referenced entity, not the source record.

config_fields.name: onNotFound
config_fields.description: When the field is blank or the row is gone: fail refuses the run as referenced_record.not_found (default). nil stores nil on resultVar; update then skips assignments and succeeds.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the referenced EntityEntry, such as product. Later steps read it as ctx[:product].stock.

step_actions.label: Related record
step_actions.description: Finds, lists, counts, creates, or updates EntityEntry rows linked through a declared association on the source record (the other end of a Student-Course link, never the bridge rows). association is that target entity's name; a numeric id is also accepted. Use child_records to read or write the link rows and their own fields, and referenced_record to follow a reference field on the source. Reads association, operation, and modelVariable. Writes the related row(s) or count to resultVar. Create writes the target and a tenant-scoped bridge row. Fails as related_record.failed on resolver errors, or related_record.not_found when find/update onNotFound is fail and nothing matches.

config_fields.name: association
config_fields.description: Name of the entity at the other end of the source record's declared association, such as Course. A numeric entity id is also accepted. Not the bridge/link entity.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: find returns the first related row. list returns rows. count returns an integer. create writes a target and a bridge row. update assigns and saves the first match.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the source EntityEntry the association starts from, such as model or student. Must be a loaded record, not an id.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Extra filters on the related target rows, such as status == Open. Ignored for create. Leave empty to include every related row.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Target-entity attributes to set on create or update, such as title => "Physics". Keys are the related entity's fields, not the source's.

config_fields.name: onNotFound
config_fields.description: When find or update matches nothing: fail refuses the run as related_record.not_found (default). nil stores nil on resultVar and the step succeeds (update then writes nothing).

config_fields.name: limit
config_fields.description: Maximum related rows list returns (1-1000, default 100). find and count ignore this.

config_fields.name: orderBy
config_fields.description: Target attribute or column to sort by, such as title or id. Blank sorts by id. Used by list and find (first after sort).

config_fields.name: orderDirection
config_fields.description: asc is lowest/oldest first (default). desc is highest/newest first, including when orderBy is blank (then by id).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable for the result: one row (find/create/update), an array (list), or an integer (count). Use a plural name such as courses for list.

step_actions.label: Save record
step_actions.description: Persists ctx[:contract] through Entries::Save after Reform#sync: the canonical page-submit write after build_contract and validate_contract. Writes ctx[:contract].model (the wrapped EntityEntry), including the page record's bridge rows on first save. onInvalid fail (default) follows a false save onto the failure track so the submitter sees contract and save errors; continue keeps going so a Decision can branch on savedVar. Fails with contract_missing when ctx[:contract] is absent. Use update_model with valuesFrom assignments to set system-filled fields after this save.

config_fields.name: onInvalid
config_fields.description: When Entries::Save returns false: fail (default) takes the failure track; continue returns success so a later Decision can branch on savedVar. Does not skip Reform validation — run validate_contract first.

config_fields.name: savedVar
config_fields.description: Optional boolean variable set to whether Entries::Save succeeded. Leave blank to skip. Useful when onInvalid is continue.

step_actions.label: Set record fields
step_actions.description: Writes attributes on a loaded EntityEntry in memory without saving. Use this to stage values before save_model, or to fill blanks on a record another step will persist; use update_model (or referenced_record / related_record operation update) when this step should save. Reads modelVariable and assignments. writeMode only_blank leaves stored values that are already present; skipNilValues leaves a field unchanged when the expression is nil. Mutates the record in place and does not write a resultVar. Fails as set_record_fields.missing_record when the path is nil, or set_record_fields.failed on an unknown attribute.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the loaded EntityEntry to mutate, such as model or product. The record is not saved; a later save_model or update_model persists it.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Entity attributes mapped to Ruby expressions, such as email => ctx[:params][:email]. Keys must belong to the record's entity. Nothing is written to the database here.

config_fields.name: writeMode
config_fields.description: overwrite replaces every mapped field (default). only_blank fills a field only when its stored value is nil or empty, leaving existing values.

config_fields.name: skipNilValues
config_fields.description: When true, a mapped expression that evaluates to nil leaves that field unchanged. When false (default), nil is written.

step_actions.label: Update record
step_actions.description: Updates an already loaded EntityEntry (modelVariable, default model) and saves it through Entries::Save. valuesFrom assignments (default) writes only the assignments mapping — the usual follow-up after save_model for system-filled fields on the page record, or to patch another loaded row such as ctx[:cart]. valuesFrom params mass-assigns ctx[:params] onto the page record; valuesFrom contract syncs ctx[:contract] onto the page record. skipIfUnchanged skips the write when nothing changed; changesVar receives saved_changes. Fails with record_missing when the variable is empty. Use set_record_fields to assign without saving, and save_model to persist a validated Reform contract.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the record to update. Default model (the page record). Use cart or another loaded variable for a different row; then valuesFrom must stay assignments.

config_fields.name: valuesFrom
config_fields.description: Which values to write before saving. assignments (default) applies only the assignments mapping. params copies ctx[:params] onto the page record. contract syncs ctx[:contract] onto the page record. params and contract are rejected when modelVariable is not model.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attributes to set after the valuesFrom source, before save. Each key is an attribute slug; each value is a Ruby expression such as Time.current. Empty by default.

config_fields.name: skipIfUnchanged
config_fields.description: When true, skip Entries::Save if the record has no pending changes after assignments. Default false (always persist, which refreshes updated_at).

config_fields.name: changesVar
config_fields.description: Optional variable that receives the record's saved_changes hash after a successful save. Leave blank to skip.

step_actions.label: Upsert record
step_actions.description: Finds one bound-entity row matching matchFields (attribute to expression, for example email from ctx[:params][:email]) and updates it, or creates it, under a tenant lock. valuesFrom assignments (default) writes only the assignments mapping plus the match keys; valuesFrom params also mass-assigns ctx[:params]. onMatch update (default) writes the found row, skip returns it unchanged, fail refuses with record_already_exists. Sets resultVar (default model) and createdVar (default created). Prefer find_model then update_model when the row must already exist, and new_model plus save_model for an always-new row.

config_fields.name: matchFields
config_fields.description: Attributes that identify an existing row. Each key is a bound-entity slug; each value is a Ruby expression, typically ctx[:params][:email]. At least one pair is required. Match keys are also written on create.

config_fields.name: valuesFrom
config_fields.description: Which values to write besides the match keys. assignments (default) uses only the assignments mapping. params mass-assigns ctx[:params] and then overlays assignments. Prefer assignments so a page submit cannot stamp unrelated posted fields onto the upserted row.

config_fields.name: assignments
config_fields.description: Bound-entity attributes to write on create or update. Each key is an attribute slug; each value is a Ruby expression such as "open". Empty by default. Overlay after params when valuesFrom is params.

config_fields.name: onMatch
config_fields.description: When a matching tenant row already exists: update (default) writes attributes onto it; skip returns it unchanged; fail refuses the submit with record_already_exists (useful for unique sign-up emails).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the found or created row. Default model.

config_fields.name: createdVar
config_fields.description: Boolean variable set to true when a new row was created, false when an existing row was found. Default created.

step_actions.label: Build Contract
step_actions.description: Wraps a loaded EntityEntry (modelVariable, default model) in a Reform form and stores it as ctx[:contract]. Uses EntityEntryContract.build_for(bound_entity, audience, writable_slugs) unless contractClass names another Reform class that implements the same build_for factory. Does not validate or save. Follow with validate_contract then save_model. Fails with record_missing when the model variable is empty. Use this once per record you will validate; after save_model, set system-filled fields with update_model assignments instead of rebuilding.

config_fields.name: contractClass
config_fields.description: Reform class used to wrap the record. Default EntityEntryContract, which builds an audience-scoped form from the bound entity schema. Must be a constant path such as EntityEntryContract or Shop::OrderContract.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the EntityEntry the form wraps. Default model (the page record seeded on submit). Use a loaded variable such as cart only when that row is the same bound entity.

step_actions.label: Fail with a business error
step_actions.description: Ends the run on the failure track with a localized message shown in the public flash. Use this for a business refusal after a decision (not eligible, quota exceeded). Use validate_value or validate_contract for field-format checks, and set_submission_outcome for a successful flash. Reads message (localized_text) and optional errorField, errorCode, messageVariables. Writes ctx[:errors] and ctx[:error_details] through Step.fail_message. Always returns false so Trailblazer takes the failure track.

config_fields.name: message
config_fields.description: Localized error shown in the public flash. Hash of locale to text, such as {"en" => "Not eligible", "zh-CN" => "Not eligible."}. Named placeholders such as %{used} are filled from messageVariables.

config_fields.name: errorField
config_fields.description: Optional form field slug to highlight on the public page, such as email or quantity. Leave blank for a page-level flash only. Must be a plain identifier.

config_fields.name: errorCode
config_fields.description: Machine-readable code stored on ctx[:error_details], such as quota_exceeded. Later steps and the submitter can branch on it. Default business_error. Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

config_fields.name: messageVariables
config_fields.description: Named placeholders interpolated into message. Each key is a placeholder name (used) and each value is a Ruby expression over ctx (ctx[:used]). Missing names are left as %{name}.

step_actions.label: Validate
step_actions.description: Runs Reform#validate on ctx[:contract] with ctx[:params] (the page's permitted submitted values) and stores the boolean on validVar (default contract_valid). Invalid fields stay on the contract so the submitter sees Errors.collect (full_messages). onInvalid fail (default) takes the failure track when validate is false; continue returns success so a Decision can branch on validVar — do not save_model on that invalid path. Fails with contract_missing when ctx[:contract] is absent. Call after build_contract; this does not persist.

config_fields.name: onInvalid
config_fields.description: When Reform#validate returns false: fail (default) takes the failure track so the submitter sees the contract errors; continue returns success so a later Decision can branch on validVar. Never save_model after continue on the invalid path.

config_fields.name: validVar
config_fields.description: Boolean variable set to the Reform#validate result. Default contract_valid. Branch a Decision on this when onInvalid is continue.

step_actions.label: Validate Value
step_actions.description: Validates one value against a business format and optionally writes a normalised copy: email, phone (including CN mobile), url, uuid, regex, length, numeric range, in_list, luhn, iban, Chinese resident ID, postal code, IP, date, date_range, or required. Reads sourceVariable. Writes resultVar (boolean) and normalizedVar. On fail (default) the submitter sees message next to errorField. Use regex_extract to pull a capture and format_value to display. Fails with validate_value.<rule> unless onInvalid is flag.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the value to check (e.g. params.email).

config_fields.name: rule
config_fields.description: Check to apply. required rejects blank. cn_mobile is a mainland China mobile number. date_range uses minDate/maxDate (ISO or today/tomorrow). phone uses phonelib.

config_fields.name: phoneCountry
config_fields.description: ISO alpha-2 country for national numbers (e.g. CN or US). Blank requires + or 00 international form.

config_fields.name: pattern
config_fields.description: Ruby regular expression the whole value must match. Example: \A\d{6}\z for a 6-digit code.

config_fields.name: minLength
config_fields.description: Shortest accepted string length (0-10000). Example: 8 for a password.

config_fields.name: maxLength
config_fields.description: Longest accepted string length (0-10000). Must be >= minLength. Default 255.

config_fields.name: minValue
config_fields.description: Lowest accepted number. Leave blank for an open lower bound. Example: 0.

config_fields.name: maxValue
config_fields.description: Highest accepted number. Leave blank for an open upper bound. Example: 100. At least one bound is required.

config_fields.name: allowedValues
config_fields.description: Exact values the source must match (e.g. active, pending). At least one is required.

config_fields.name: caseSensitive
config_fields.description: When on, list comparison is case-sensitive. Off treats Active and active as the same.

config_fields.name: postalCountry
config_fields.description: ISO alpha-2 country whose postal-code pattern is applied (US, CN, GB, CA, DE, FR, JP, AU, NL, IN, BR, IT, ES, KR, SG).

config_fields.name: urlSchemes
config_fields.description: Allowed URL schemes. Default https and http. javascript: is never accepted unless listed (do not list it).

config_fields.name: dateFormat
config_fields.description: strptime pattern used to parse the date (e.g. %Y-%m-%d or %d/%m/%Y).

config_fields.name: ipVersion
config_fields.description: Require IPv4 (v4), IPv6 (v6), or either (any).

config_fields.name: minDate
config_fields.description: Inclusive lower date as YYYY-MM-DD, today, or tomorrow. Blank is an open lower bound.

config_fields.name: maxDate
config_fields.description: Inclusive upper date as YYYY-MM-DD, today, or tomorrow. Blank is an open upper bound.

config_fields.name: allowBlank
config_fields.description: Treat a blank source as valid (except the required rule, which always rejects blank).

config_fields.name: onInvalid
config_fields.description: fail stops the flowchart and shows the error; flag only writes resultVar false so a later step can branch.

config_fields.name: errorField
config_fields.description: Form field name attached to the error so the input can be highlighted (e.g. email). Blank is unscoped.

config_fields.name: message
config_fields.description: Custom localized error shown to the submitter. Blank uses the per-rule default under flowchart_runtime.errors.validate_value.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable set to true when the value is valid and false when it is not.

config_fields.name: normalizedVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the canonical value when valid (e.g. lowercase email, E.164 phone).

step_actions.label: Assign Value
step_actions.description: Writes a value into the ctx variable named by resultVar. Use this to set a constant, copy another ctx path (ctx_ref), evaluate a short Ruby expression, or pick the first non-blank of several fields (first_present, e.g. preferred_name then name). Use generate_id for identifiers, calculate for aggregates over lists, and map_value to translate a status into a label. Reads the configured source; writes resultVar. Assigning nil or false still succeeds. Fails only when a required field is missing at design time.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: display_name.

config_fields.name: valueType
config_fields.description: Kind of value to write. string/integer/float/boolean/array/hash are literals; expression is Ruby such as ctx[:count].to_i + 1; null writes nil; ctx_ref copies another path; first_present picks the first non-blank candidate.

config_fields.name: valueExpression
config_fields.description: Ruby expression stored in resultVar when valueType is expression. Example: ctx[:qty].to_i * ctx[:unit_price].to_f.

config_fields.name: stringValue
config_fields.description: Literal string stored when valueType is string. Example: pending.

config_fields.name: integerValue
config_fields.description: Literal integer stored when valueType is integer. Example: 0 or 42.

config_fields.name: floatValue
config_fields.description: Literal number stored when valueType is float. Example: 19.99.

config_fields.name: booleanValue
config_fields.description: Literal true or false stored when valueType is boolean. Default false.

config_fields.name: arrayValue
config_fields.description: Literal list stored when valueType is array. Example: pending, paid.

config_fields.name: hashValue
config_fields.description: Literal key/value pairs stored when valueType is hash. Example: status=draft.

config_fields.name: ctxRefVariable
config_fields.description: Existing ctx path to copy when valueType is ctx_ref. Example: order.status or source.

config_fields.name: candidates
config_fields.description: Ctx paths tried in order until one is present (not blank). Example: preferred_name, name.

config_fields.name: literalCandidates
config_fields.description: Fallback literals tried after candidates. Example: Guest. Empty means no literal fallback.

step_actions.label: Calculate
step_actions.description: Aggregates a list of hashes or EntityEntry records: sum, count, avg, min, max, product, or concat of a field such as line-item amount. Use filter_collection to pick which rows, collection_manipulate to sort or group first, and assign_value for a single expression. Reads sourceVariable; writes resultVar. Empty lists return 0 or nil per emptyCollectionBehavior. Nil item values are skipped when ignoreNils is true. Does not fail at runtime for an empty list.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the list to aggregate. Example: line_items or items.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: Aggregation to apply. count is the list size; sum/avg/min/max/product/concat read fieldName on each item (e.g. amount). product multiplies numeric values; concat joins them.

config_fields.name: fieldName
config_fields.description: Item field aggregated for sum, avg, min, max, product, or concat. Dotted paths allowed. Example: amount or item.price. Leave blank to use the item itself.

config_fields.name: separator
config_fields.description: String inserted between concatenated values. Example: ', ' for a name list. Default is no separator.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: order_total.

config_fields.name: emptyCollectionBehavior
config_fields.description: Value when the list (or field values) is empty. zero writes 0; nil writes nil. Default zero.

config_fields.name: ignoreNils
config_fields.description: Drop nil items and nil field values before aggregating. Default true so a missing amount does not spoil a sum.

config_fields.name: precision
config_fields.description: Decimal places to round sum/avg/min/max/product. 0 means no rounding. Example: 2 for money.

config_fields.name: roundingMode
config_fields.description: How to round when precision is set. half_up is school rounding; half_even is banker's; floor goes down; ceiling goes up.

step_actions.label: Collection Manipulate
step_actions.description: Rewrites a list of hashes or EntityEntry records: map (rename fields), pluck (extract a column such as emails), group (bucket by status), sort, unique (de-duplicate by field), or flatten nested arrays. Use filter_collection to keep or drop rows, calculate to sum a field, and hash_manipulate for a single hash. Reads sourceVariable; writes resultVar. Record fields are read via flowchart_value. Does not fail unless the operation input is invalid.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: How to rewrite the list. map reshapes each item via fieldMappings; pluck extracts fields (one field returns a flat list); group buckets by groupField; sort orders by sortField; unique drops duplicates; flatten unwraps nested arrays.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the list to rewrite. Example: line_items or items.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: emails or grouped_orders.

config_fields.name: fieldMappings
config_fields.description: Source field path to target key for each mapped item. Example: name -> label. Keys on the result are symbols.

config_fields.name: compactResult
config_fields.description: Drop nil items from the mapped list. Default false keeps them.

config_fields.name: fields
config_fields.description: Field paths to extract. One field returns a flat list of values (e.g. emails); several fields return a list of hashes with optional aliases.

config_fields.name: groupField
config_fields.description: Item field used as the group key. Example: status or category.

config_fields.name: includeCount
config_fields.description: Store each group as {items, count} instead of just the rows. Default false.

config_fields.name: sortGroups
config_fields.description: Order of keys in the grouped hash. none keeps insertion order; key_asc/key_desc sort by key; count_asc/count_desc sort by group size.

config_fields.name: sortField
config_fields.description: Item field used to sort. Example: amount or created_at.

config_fields.name: sortDirection
config_fields.description: Sort order. asc is low to high (A-Z, oldest first); desc is high to low.

config_fields.name: nullsFirst
config_fields.description: Place items with a nil sort field before the others. Default false leaves them where Ruby sort_by puts them.

config_fields.name: uniqField
config_fields.description: Item field used to decide uniqueness. Leave blank to compare whole items. Example: email.

config_fields.name: keepStrategy
config_fields.description: Which duplicate to keep. first keeps the earliest item; last keeps the latest. Default first.

config_fields.name: depth
config_fields.description: How many array levels to unwrap. 1 flattens one nesting; 0 flattens all the way. Default 1.

config_fields.name: removeNilElements
config_fields.description: Drop nils after flattening. Default false keeps them.

step_actions.label: Compare Data
step_actions.description: Compares two hashes (for example an order before and after an edit). comparisonType diff (default) writes added, removed, and changed fields into resultVar; equal writes a boolean. Use hash_manipulate to pick keys first, and ignoreKeys to skip timestamps such as updated_at. Reads sourceVariable and otherVariable. Fails with compare_data.failed when a side is not a hash.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the left (before) hash. Example: before or original_order.

config_fields.name: otherVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the right (after) hash. Example: after or updated_order.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. For diff this is a hash of added/removed/changed; for equal it is true or false.

config_fields.name: comparisonType
config_fields.description: diff writes {added, removed, changed: {key => {from, to}}}; equal writes a boolean. Default diff.

config_fields.name: ignoreKeys
config_fields.description: Keys stripped from both sides before compare. Example: updated_at, created_at.

config_fields.name: caseInsensitive
config_fields.description: Downcase strings on both sides before comparing. Default false.

config_fields.name: numericTolerance
config_fields.description: Absolute difference allowed for numeric values (e.g. 0.01 for money). 0 requires exact equality.

step_actions.label: Date/Time Calc
step_actions.description: Calculates dates and times in the run time zone: current time, add or subtract a duration (including business days), start or end of a period, difference in a unit, compare two instants, age in whole years from a birth date, parse, format, or convert a timezone. Reads sourceVariable (and endVariable for difference, compare, and age-at). Writes resultVar. Use format_value for locale-aware display and next_occurrence for recurring due dates. Fails with date_time_calc.failed when the source cannot be parsed or a timezone is invalid.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: Calculation to run. now is Time.current (no source). add/subtract shift source by amount and unit. difference is end minus source in unit. start_of/end_of snap to the period. age is whole years from source to now or endVariable. compare is -1/0/1. format uses formatString. parse reads a string. convert_timezone maps clocks.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the Time, integer (difference, age, compare), or formatted string.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the source time (e.g. params.starts_on). Unused for now. Accepts a Time, Date, or parseable string.

config_fields.name: endVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the second instant. Required for difference and compare; optional for age as the as-of date instead of now (e.g. params.ends_on).

config_fields.name: amount
config_fields.description: How many units to add or subtract (0-10000). Example: 14 with unit days is two weeks.

config_fields.name: unit
config_fields.description: Duration unit for add, subtract, and difference, and the period for start_of/end_of (days is beginning/end of day). seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years.

config_fields.name: formatString
config_fields.description: strftime pattern used by format. Example: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M. Use format_value for locale display.

config_fields.name: inputFormat
config_fields.description: strptime pattern for parse, or blank/iso to use Time.zone.parse. Example: %d/%m/%Y.

config_fields.name: outputFormat
config_fields.description: How to write a Time result: blank keeps the Time; iso8601, rfc3339, unix, unix_ms, or a strftime pattern such as %Y-%m-%d.

config_fields.name: businessDays
config_fields.description: When adding or subtracting days or weeks, skip Saturdays and Sundays (weeks counts five days each).

config_fields.name: timezoneAware
config_fields.description: Interpret times in Time.zone (or timezone when set). Off leaves a Time object in its own zone.

config_fields.name: timezone
config_fields.description: IANA timezone such as Asia/Shanghai. Blank with timezoneAware uses Time.zone.

config_fields.name: dstPolicy
config_fields.description: How add/subtract crosses DST. preserve_wall keeps clock time (Rails default); preserve_utc shifts the UTC instant then converts back.

config_fields.name: sourceTimezone
config_fields.description: IANA zone of the source clock for convert_timezone. Example: UTC or America/New_York.

config_fields.name: targetTimezone
config_fields.description: IANA zone to convert into for convert_timezone. Example: Asia/Shanghai. Default UTC.

config_fields.name: preserveLocalTime
config_fields.description: For convert_timezone, keep wall-clock fields and change the zone instead of converting the instant.

config_fields.name: dstBehavior
config_fields.description: When preserveLocalTime hits an ambiguous DST time: raise_on_ambiguous fails the step; prefer_earlier or prefer_later picks that offset.

step_actions.label: Filter Collection
step_actions.description: Keeps, splits, or inspects items in a list of hashes or EntityEntry records by field comparison (eq, ne, gt, lt, gte, lte, includes, blank, present). Use collection_manipulate to sort, group, or pluck, and calculate to aggregate the result. Reads sourceVariable; writes resultVar (and rejectedVar when returns is split). returns can be the matching items, first/last match, index, count, or a boolean (any/all/none). Record fields are read via flowchart_value. Does not fail for an empty list.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the list to filter. Example: orders or line_items.

config_fields.name: returns
config_fields.description: What to store. items is the matching rows; split also fills rejectedVar; first/last/index pick one match; count is a number; any/all/none are booleans.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: open_orders.

config_fields.name: rejectedVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives items that failed the predicate when returns is split. Example: closed_orders.

config_fields.name: filterMode
config_fields.description: single compares one field; multi joins a list of conditions with AND or OR.

config_fields.name: filterField
config_fields.description: Item field compared in single mode. Dotted paths allowed. Example: status or item.sku.

config_fields.name: filterOperator
config_fields.description: Comparison against filterValue. eq/ne equality; gt/lt/gte/lte numeric or date order; includes substring or array membership; blank/present ignore filterValue.

config_fields.name: filterValue
config_fields.description: Value compared to the field for eq/ne/gt/lt/gte/lte/includes. Example: active or 10. Unused for blank/present.

config_fields.name: conditions
config_fields.description: Rows of {field, operator, value} joined by conditionOperator. Example: status eq active.

config_fields.name: conditionOperator
config_fields.description: How multiple conditions are joined. AND requires every row; OR requires any row. Default AND.

config_fields.name: rejectMode
config_fields.description: Keep items that fail the predicate instead of those that match. Default false.

config_fields.name: nilHandling
config_fields.description: How nil items are treated. treat_as_false skips them; include counts them as matches; exclude drops them before testing. Default treat_as_false.

config_fields.name: limit
config_fields.description: Maximum matched (and rejected, when splitting) items to keep. 0 keeps all. Example: 10.

config_fields.name: defaultValue
config_fields.description: Value stored when first, last, or index finds nothing. Example: none. Empty stores nil.

step_actions.label: Format Value
step_actions.description: Formats a value for templates, documents, and messages in the run locale: number, currency, percentage, delimited, human_size, human_number, phone (phonelib), date, or datetime (I18n.l). Reads sourceVariable. Writes resultVar as a string. Honors ctx[:locale] when locale is blank. Use date_time_calc for date math and math_operation for decimal arithmetic. Fails with format_value.failed on an invalid timezone; writes fallbackValue when the source is blank or cannot be formatted.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the value to format (e.g. params.amount, a Time, or a phone string).

config_fields.name: formatType
config_fields.description: How to present the value. number/currency/percentage/delimited/human_* use NumberHelper; phone uses phonelib; date and datetime use I18n.l or iso8601/custom strftime.

config_fields.name: locale
config_fields.description: I18n locale for number and date formats (e.g. en or zh-CN). Blank uses ctx[:locale] or I18n.locale.

config_fields.name: precision
config_fields.description: Digits after the decimal, or significant digits for human_size and human_number (0-10). Default 2.

config_fields.name: currencyUnit
config_fields.description: Currency symbol or code passed to number_to_currency (e.g. $ or CNY). Blank uses the locale default.

config_fields.name: delimiter
config_fields.description: Thousands delimiter (e.g. , or .). Blank uses the locale number.format.delimiter.

config_fields.name: separator
config_fields.description: Decimal separator (e.g. . or ,). Blank uses the locale number.format.separator.

config_fields.name: stripInsignificantZeros
config_fields.description: Drop trailing zeros after the decimal (1.50 becomes 1.5).

config_fields.name: phoneCountry
config_fields.description: ISO alpha-2 country used to parse a national number (e.g. CN or US). Blank requires an international number.

config_fields.name: phoneStyle
config_fields.description: How to print a valid phone: international (+86 138 ...), national, or e164 (+86138...).

config_fields.name: dateStyle
config_fields.description: Date format: default, short, and long use I18n.l; iso8601 is ISO; custom uses customFormat.

config_fields.name: customFormat
config_fields.description: strftime pattern when dateStyle is custom. Example: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M.

config_fields.name: timezone
config_fields.description: IANA timezone for datetime (e.g. Asia/Shanghai). Blank uses Time.zone.

config_fields.name: fallbackValue
config_fields.description: Text written when the source is nil or cannot be formatted. Example: — or n/a. Blank writes an empty string.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the formatted display string.

step_actions.label: Generate ID
step_actions.description: Generates an identifier with SecureRandom: uuid (default), nanoid (short URL-safe code), hex (token), or custom_pattern (strftime plus a random suffix, e.g. ORD-%Y%m%d-). Optional prefix and separator produce values such as user_ followed by the id. Use assign_value for constants and hash_data for a digest of existing data. Writes resultVar. Fails with generate_id.failed on an unsupported type or empty nanoid alphabet.

config_fields.name: idType
config_fields.description: Kind of identifier. uuid is a RFC 4122 id; nanoid is a short URL-safe code; hex is a random hex token; custom_pattern is Time.zone strftime plus six random characters.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: confirmation_code or order_id.

config_fields.name: length
config_fields.description: Character length for nanoid (default 21) or hex (even lengths preferred). Example: 8 for a short code.

config_fields.name: alphabet
config_fields.description: Characters nanoid may use. Leave blank for the default URL-safe alphabet. Example: 0123456789ABCDEF.

config_fields.name: pattern
config_fields.description: strftime pattern prepended to six random characters. Example: ORD-%Y%m%d- yields ORD-20261123-Ab12Cd.

config_fields.name: prefix
config_fields.description: Text prepended to the generated identifier. Example: user or ORD. Empty means no prefix.

config_fields.name: separator
config_fields.description: Text between the prefix and the identifier when prefix is set. Example: _ or -. Ignored when prefix is empty.

config_fields.name: uppercase
config_fields.description: Uppercase the generated identifier (not the prefix). Default false.

step_actions.label: Hash Manipulate
step_actions.description: Reshapes one hash: pick or omit keys, merge another hash, rename keys, compact nils, set computed keys, or list keys/values. Use compare_data to diff two hashes, collection_manipulate for arrays of records, and map_value to translate a single value. Reads sourceVariable (and otherVariable for merge); writes resultVar. Fails with hash_manipulate.failed when the source is not a hash.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the hash this step reads. Example: payload or person.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: public_profile.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: How to reshape the source. pick keeps keys; omit drops them; keys/values list them; merge combines otherVariable; rename_keys uses renameMap; compact drops nils; set_keys writes computedFields.

config_fields.name: keys
config_fields.description: Key names to pick or omit. Dotted paths pick a nested value under the last segment. Example: name, email.

config_fields.name: otherVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the second hash merged into the source. Example: overrides or defaults.

config_fields.name: renameMap
config_fields.description: Original key mapped to the new key. Example: first_name -> given_name.

config_fields.name: computedFields
config_fields.description: Keys to set, each with a Ruby expression for the value. Example: total = ctx[:qty].to_i * ctx[:price].to_f.

config_fields.name: caseInsensitive
config_fields.description: Match pick/omit keys without regard to letter case. Default false.

config_fields.name: mergeStrategy
config_fields.description: How the two hashes combine. shallow overwrites top-level keys; deep merges nested hashes; replace returns the other hash; append concatenates array values.

config_fields.name: arrayMergeMode
config_fields.description: How array values combine on a deep or append merge. concat joins them; replace uses the other hash; unique_union concatenates and uniq. Default concat.

config_fields.name: onConflict
config_fields.description: Which side wins when both hashes share a key. last uses the other hash; first keeps the source. Default last.

step_actions.label: Log
step_actions.description: Writes a message to the Rails logger or a tenant-scoped file under tmp/flowchart_logs. Use this for operator diagnostics, not for storing business data (use assign_value or create_model). Sensitive tag keys (password, token, secret, ssn, card) are redacted. Reads optional tag ctx paths; writes nothing into a result variable. Fails with log.failed when the file logger has no tenant or an unsafe filePath.

config_fields.name: logLevel
config_fields.description: Severity written with the message. debug/info/warn/error/fatal map to Rails.logger methods. Default info.

config_fields.name: messageTemplate
config_fields.description: Message to write. Plain text, or a Liquid template such as Order {{ order_number }} paid.

config_fields.name: logger
config_fields.description: Where the message is written. rails uses Rails.logger; file appends under tmp/flowchart_logs/<customer_id>/.

config_fields.name: filePath
config_fields.description: Basename of the tenant log file (no directories). Example: payments.log. Required when logger is file.

config_fields.name: tags
config_fields.description: Extra values attached to a structured JSON log. Keys matching password/token/secret/ssn/card are redacted. Example: order_id -> order.id.

config_fields.name: includeBacktrace
config_fields.description: Append the call stack on error and fatal levels. Default false. Ignored for debug/info/warn.

config_fields.name: structured
config_fields.description: Write a JSON payload with level, message, timestamp, and tags. Default false writes the message text.

config_fields.name: maxMessageLength
config_fields.description: Truncate the message to this many characters. 0 means no truncation. Example: 500.

step_actions.label: Map Value
step_actions.description: Looks up a value in a table and writes the mapped result (status code to a label, score band to a grade). exact matches a key, regex matches a pattern, range matches min..max. Use assign_value for a constant, type_cast to convert types, and hash_manipulate.pick to extract one field first. Reads sourceVariable; writes resultVar. fallbackStrategy default uses defaultValue, pass_through returns the input, raise fails with map_value.failed when nothing matches.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the value to look up. Example: status or score.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable later steps read. Example: status_label.

config_fields.name: matchMode
config_fields.description: How input values match rows. exact compares keys; regex matches a pattern such as ^paid; range matches 0..50. Default exact.

config_fields.name: mappings
config_fields.description: Input value mapped to the output value for exact mode. Example: paid -> Paid, void -> Cancelled.

config_fields.name: rules
config_fields.description: Pattern (regex) or range (1..10 or 1...10) mapped to the output value. First match wins.

config_fields.name: defaultValue
config_fields.description: Value used when nothing matches and fallbackStrategy is default. Example: Unknown.

config_fields.name: fallbackStrategy
config_fields.description: When nothing matches: default writes defaultValue; pass_through writes the input; raise fails the step with map_value.failed.

config_fields.name: caseSensitive
config_fields.description: Match letter case for exact and regex. Default true. Set false so PAID matches paid.

step_actions.label: Math Operation
step_actions.description: Performs decimal arithmetic with BigDecimal so money totals stay exact: add, subtract, multiply, divide, modulo, power, min, max, percent (source as a percentage of other), abs, floor, ceil, round, sqrt, clamp, and integer random. Reads sourceVariable and, for binary ops, otherVariable. Writes resultVar. Use format_value to display currency and calculate for collection totals. Fails with math_operation.failed on a non-numeric value or when divideByZero is raise and the divisor is zero.

config_fields.name: operation
config_fields.description: Math to apply. Binary ops need otherVariable. percent is source/other*100. clamp pins source between minValue and maxValue. random is an integer in that range. round uses precision and roundingMode.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the first operand (e.g. params.subtotal). Unused for random.

config_fields.name: otherVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the second operand for add, subtract, multiply, divide, modulo, power, min, max, and percent (e.g. params.tax).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the BigDecimal result (or an integer for random).

config_fields.name: precision
config_fields.description: Decimal places to round to (0-20). Blank keeps full precision. Example: 2 for money.

config_fields.name: roundingMode
config_fields.description: How precision rounds: half_up (default, 0.5 away from zero), half_even (banker's), floor (toward -inf), ceiling (toward +inf).

config_fields.name: divideByZero
config_fields.description: When the divisor is zero: raise fails the step, nil writes nil, zero writes 0, infinity and nan write those IEEE values.

config_fields.name: minValue
config_fields.description: Inclusive lower bound for clamp and random. Example: 0.

config_fields.name: maxValue
config_fields.description: Inclusive upper bound for clamp and random. Example: 100. Must be >= minValue.

step_actions.label: Parse Data
step_actions.description: Parses a JSON, CSV, XML, YAML, or TOML string into structured data. Reads sourceVariable. Writes resultVar as a Hash or Array. YAML uses YAML.safe_load (Date and Time only, no aliases). Use serialize_data to go the other way and regex_extract for a single capture from text. Fails with parse_data.failed when the payload is malformed or larger than 1 MB.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the raw string to parse (e.g. params.body or a webhook payload).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the parsed Hash or Array of rows.

config_fields.name: format
config_fields.description: Payload format: json, csv (rows of hashes when csvHeaders is on), xml, yaml (safe_load), or toml.

config_fields.name: csvHeaders
config_fields.description: Treat the first CSV row as column names and return an array of hashes. Off returns arrays of cells.

config_fields.name: csvDelimiter
config_fields.description: CSV column separator. Example: , or ; or a tab character.

config_fields.name: quoteChar
config_fields.description: CSV quote character wrapping cells that contain the delimiter. Example: ".

config_fields.name: skipRows
config_fields.description: Number of leading lines to drop before parsing (0-10000). Example: 1 to skip a title row.

config_fields.name: encoding
config_fields.description: Character encoding of the CSV bytes: utf-8 (default), utf-16, ascii, or iso-8859-1.

config_fields.name: colTypes
config_fields.description: Named CSV columns to cast. Keys are header names; values are string, integer, float, bool, or date.

config_fields.name: xmlRoot
config_fields.description: Optional XML root key to unwrap from Hash.from_xml (e.g. order). Blank keeps the full hash.

config_fields.name: symbolizeKeys
config_fields.description: Convert top-level hash keys to symbols for json, yaml, and toml. Leave off for string keys.

step_actions.label: Read a Constant
step_actions.description: Reads a Constant's option list, or the label for one value, using this customer's override when the constant is shared. Use this to show or branch on configured labels (order status, ticket type); do not use it for entity records (query_models / find_model) or for the signed-in user (load_current_user). constant is the Constant's id or name. returns options writes the array to resultVar; returns label looks up value and writes that option's label, or defaultValue (nil when omitted) when the value is not in the list. Fails as read_setting.failed when the constant is missing or belongs to another tenant.

config_fields.name: constant
config_fields.description: Constant to read: its numeric id, or its name such as OrderStatus. Shared constants use this customer's override options when present.

config_fields.name: returns
config_fields.description: options writes the option list (array of values or {label, value} hashes) to resultVar. label looks up one value and writes that option's display label.

config_fields.name: value
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the option value whose label is returned, such as ctx[:params][:status] or ctx[:model].status. Required when returns is label.

config_fields.name: defaultValue
config_fields.description: Ruby expression returned when value is not in this customer's list, such as "Unknown". Omit or nil to store nil.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the option list or the resolved label, such as constant_options.

step_actions.label: Regex Extract
