config_fields.name: validateChecksum
config_fields.description: Optional digest of the body: sha256: plus 64 hex chars, md5: plus 32 hex chars, or a bare 32/64 hex string. Mismatch fails the step.

config_fields.name: connectTimeout
config_fields.description: Seconds to wait for the connection to open (1-5). connectTimeout + readTimeout must stay within 10 seconds.

config_fields.name: readTimeout
config_fields.description: Seconds to wait for the response once connected (1-9); a slower answer fails the step.

config_fields.name: retryOnTransportError
config_fields.description: Retry once more when the connection fails before any response arrives. Allowed only for idempotent requests, so a retried call cannot act twice.

config_fields.name: retryAttempts
config_fields.description: Extra attempts after a transport failure (1-2) when retryOnTransportError is on.

config_fields.name: circuitBreaker
config_fields.description: Stop calling the remote service for a while after repeated failures, failing fast instead of waiting on every run.

config_fields.name: breakerName
config_fields.description: Name of the breaker; steps that call the same service share one name so they trip together.

config_fields.name: failureThreshold
config_fields.description: Consecutive failures that open the breaker (1-20).

config_fields.name: resetTimeoutSeconds
config_fields.description: Seconds the breaker stays open before one trial call is let through (10-3600).

step_actions.label: Generate document
step_actions.description: Renders a PDF (title, body, optional table) with Prawn and stores an ActiveStorage blob tagged with customer_id. Use send_email attachmentsVariable to attach it, or upload_file to push the blob elsewhere. Reads title/body/header/footer/filename as Liquid, sourceVariable rows, columns, pageSize, orientation, and pageNumbers. Writes resultVar (default document) as a hash: blob_id, signed_id, filename, content_type, byte_size, checksum, customer_id. Fails with generate_document.failed on Prawn or template errors.

config_fields.name: title
config_fields.description: Document title. Liquid placeholders resolve from ctx, e.g. Invoice {{ name }}.

config_fields.name: body
config_fields.description: Body paragraphs. Liquid placeholders resolve from ctx. Lines starting with ## become headings.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path of optional table rows (array of hashes), e.g. rows or line_items. Blank skips the table.

config_fields.name: columns
config_fields.description: Table column header mapped to a row field, e.g. Item => item, Qty => qty. Empty prints row values in hash order.

config_fields.name: pageSize
config_fields.description: Paper size of the generated PDF: a4 (default), letter, or legal.

config_fields.name: orientation
config_fields.description: Page layout: portrait (default) or landscape.

config_fields.name: header
config_fields.description: Optional header drawn at the top of every page. Liquid placeholders resolve from ctx. Blank draws none.

config_fields.name: footer
config_fields.description: Optional footer drawn at the bottom of every page. Liquid placeholders resolve from ctx. Blank draws none.

config_fields.name: pageNumbers
config_fields.description: When true, prints a page number (n / total) on every page. Default false.

config_fields.name: filename
config_fields.description: Filename stored on the ActiveStorage blob, e.g. invoice-{{ name }}.pdf. Default document.pdf; .pdf is appended if missing.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx key for the blob hash (default document). Pass this path to send_email attachmentsVariable to attach the PDF.

step_actions.label: Generate File
step_actions.description: Exports a collection of hashes or EntityEntry rows to a CSV, XLSX, JSON, or TXT file payload {filename, content, content_type} in resultVar. Use this for spreadsheet downloads and Excel-friendly CSVs (UTF-8 with BOM by default). For a designed PDF with title, body, and table, use generate_document instead. Reads sourceVariable. Column headers that look like I18n keys are translated in the run locale; dates are formatted with I18n.l. upload_file, compress_files, and send_email attachments consume the payload. Fails with generate_file.failed when the type is unknown or the workbook cannot be built.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the rows to export, for example rows or records. Each item is a hash or EntityEntry; attribute slugs are read through flowchart_value.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the file payload {filename, content, content_type} for upload_file, compress_files, or send_email attachments.

config_fields.name: fileType
config_fields.description: Output format. csv is UTF-8 text (Excel BOM on by default); xlsx is an Excel workbook; json is a JSON array; txt is one line per row. Use generate_document for PDFs.

config_fields.name: columns
config_fields.description: Header-to-field map for csv and xlsx. key is the header text or an I18n key (resolved in the run locale); value is the row attribute slug such as name. Empty uses every key on the first row.

config_fields.name: sheetName
config_fields.description: Worksheet name for xlsx, for example Orders. Must be 1-31 Excel characters and cannot contain []*/\?:.

config_fields.name: autoFilter
config_fields.description: When true, enables the Excel auto-filter on the header row so staff can sort and filter in Excel.

config_fields.name: pretty
config_fields.description: When true, pretty-prints JSON with indentation. Leave off for compact machine-readable dumps.

config_fields.name: lineEnding
config_fields.description: Line break for txt. lf is Unix newline; crlf is Windows CRLF for Notepad-friendly files.

config_fields.name: filenameTemplate
config_fields.description: Liquid filename such as orders-{{ "now" | date: "%Y%m%d" }}.csv. When blank, export.<fileType> is used.

config_fields.name: delimiter
config_fields.description: CSV column separator. Use a comma (default) for Excel in the US; use a semicolon for many European locales.

config_fields.name: headerRow
config_fields.description: When true (default), write a header row of column names. Turn off only for headerless machine imports.

config_fields.name: quoteStrings
config_fields.description: When true, quote every CSV field. Use this when values may contain the delimiter, quotes, or newlines.

config_fields.name: includeBom
config_fields.description: When true (default), prefix CSV with a UTF-8 BOM so Microsoft Excel recognises the encoding. Turn off for strict UTF-8 consumers.

config_fields.name: nestedSeparator
config_fields.description: Separator for nested hash paths in csv column values, for example address.city with '.'. Default is a dot.

step_actions.label: Upload File
step_actions.description: Attaches a file to a File or Image field through Active Storage. Use after generate_file, download_file or generate_document to keep the file on the record. Reads modelVariable, fileField and sourceVariable. Replaces a single-file field; appends to a multiple-file field. Saves through Entries::Save unless saveRecord is off, so accepted types, the 25 MB limit and the image check refuse a bad file. Writes resultVar with {blob_id, signed_id, filename, content_type, byte_size}. Fails with upload_file.failed when the record, field or file is missing or belongs to another tenant.

config_fields.name: modelVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the EntityEntry that receives the file, such as model (the page record) or order.

config_fields.name: fileField
config_fields.description: Slug of the record's File or Image attribute that receives the file, such as contract or photo. Any other kind of attribute is refused.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the file: a file payload {filename, content, content_type} from generate_file or download_file, a generate_document result ({blob_id, ...}), raw bytes, or another record's file field such as customer_record.photo.

config_fields.name: filename
config_fields.description: Optional Liquid filename that replaces the source's, such as invoice-{{ order.number }}.pdf. Blank keeps the source filename (upload.bin for raw bytes).

config_fields.name: saveRecord
config_fields.description: On (default) saves the record now, so the file is stored and checked. Off only stages the file for a later save_model or update_model step on the same record.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives {blob_id, signed_id, filename, content_type, byte_size} for the attached file. blob_id and signed_id are nil while saveRecord is off.

step_actions.label: Cache Delete
step_actions.description: Invalidates tenant-scoped flowchart cache entries for this customer only. Use cache_write or cache_fetch to populate keys and tags. scope 'key' deletes one Liquid cacheKey; 'pattern' deletes glob matches under this tenant (refuses at 10,000 keys when confirmPattern is true); 'namespace' deletes every key under the cacheKey prefix; 'all' clears this tenant's flowchart cache; 'tagged' invalidates the named tags. Bulk scopes enumerate via FlowchartRuntime::CacheScope (Solid Cache has no delete_matched) and cannot reach another tenant. Fails with cache_delete.failed on a bad key, a confirmation breach, or a missing tenant.

config_fields.name: scope
config_fields.description: 'key' deletes one cacheKey. 'pattern' globs under this tenant. 'namespace' deletes the cacheKey prefix. 'all' clears this tenant. 'tagged' invalidates tags.

config_fields.name: cacheKey
config_fields.description: For 'key', a Liquid key such as 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}'. For 'pattern', a glob like 'order:*'. For 'namespace', a prefix like 'order'.

config_fields.name: tags
config_fields.description: Tag names whose members are deleted when scope is 'tagged', matching tags set on cache_write.

config_fields.name: confirmPattern
config_fields.description: When true (default), refuse a pattern delete that matches 10,000 or more keys for this tenant.

step_actions.label: Cache Fetch
step_actions.description: Read-through cache: return a tenant-scoped Rails.cache hit, or compute fallbackExpression, store it, and return it. Use cache_read to look up without computing, cache_write to store an already-known value, and cache_delete to invalidate. cacheKey is a Liquid template such as 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}'. Writes the value to resultVar. Optional ttl, namespace, versionKey, raceConditionTtl, forceRefresh (ignore a hit), and skipNilCache (default true, do not store nil). Fails with cache_fetch.failed when the tenant is missing or the key is blank or contains a wildcard.

config_fields.name: cacheKey
config_fields.description: Liquid template for the tenant-scoped key, e.g. 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}'. Static text is fine. Wildcards are refused.

config_fields.name: fallbackExpression
config_fields.description: ctx path computed on a miss and then stored, e.g. 'order_total'. Must be a ctx identifier, not Ruby.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that receives the hit or the computed fallback. Default 'cached'.

config_fields.name: ttl
config_fields.description: Seconds until the stored value expires (1-86400). Blank keeps it until cache_delete or eviction.

config_fields.name: raceConditionTtl
config_fields.description: Extra seconds Rails.cache keeps a stale value during a stampede (1-3600). Leave blank to disable.

config_fields.name: forceRefresh
config_fields.description: When true, ignore a cached hit and recompute fallbackExpression. Default false.

config_fields.name: skipNilCache
config_fields.description: When true (default), a nil fallback is returned but not stored, so the next run recomputes.

config_fields.name: namespace
config_fields.description: Optional literal prefix inserted before the key, e.g. 'reports'. Leave blank for none.

config_fields.name: versionKey
config_fields.description: Optional version token such as 'v2'. A changed version misses the old entry.

step_actions.label: Cache Read
step_actions.description: Reads one tenant-scoped Rails.cache value into ctx. Prefer cache_fetch when a miss should compute and store a fallback, cache_write to store a known value, and cache_delete to invalidate. cacheKey is a Liquid template such as 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}' and is always prefixed with this customer_id. Writes the entry to resultVar (default 'cached'). onMiss 'nil' leaves a miss as nil; 'default' assigns defaultValue. The step still succeeds on a miss. Fails with cache_read.failed when the tenant is missing or the key is blank or contains a wildcard.

config_fields.name: cacheKey
config_fields.description: Liquid template for the tenant-scoped key, e.g. 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}'. Static text is fine. Wildcards are refused.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that receives the cached value or the on-miss default. Default 'cached'.

config_fields.name: namespace
config_fields.description: Optional literal prefix inserted before the key, e.g. 'reports'. Leave blank for none.

config_fields.name: versionCheck
config_fields.description: Optional version token such as 'v2', or a ctx[:name] path. A changed version misses the old entry.

config_fields.name: onMiss
config_fields.description: 'nil' (default) leaves resultVar nil on a miss and still succeeds. 'default' assigns defaultValue instead.

config_fields.name: defaultValue
config_fields.description: Ruby expression assigned when onMiss is 'default' and the key is absent, such as {}, 0 or ctx[:fallback].

step_actions.label: Cache Write
step_actions.description: Stores a ctx value in the tenant-scoped Rails.cache. Use cache_fetch for read-through filling, cache_read to look up without writing, and cache_delete to invalidate. cacheKey is a Liquid template (e.g. 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}') scoped by customer_id. Reads sourceVariable and writes it under that key. action 'write' overwrites; 'write_if_absent' uses unless_exist so a populated key is left alone. Optional ttl (seconds), namespace, version, tags (for cache_delete tagged), and raceConditionTtl (stampede guard). Fails with cache_write.failed on a blank/wildcard key or missing tenant. The step succeeds even when write_if_absent skips.

config_fields.name: cacheKey
config_fields.description: Liquid template for the tenant-scoped key, e.g. 'order_summary:{{ model.id }}'. Static text is fine. Wildcards are refused.

config_fields.name: action
config_fields.description: 'write' (default) overwrites the key. 'write_if_absent' stores only when the key is missing (unless_exist).

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path holding the value to store, e.g. 'order' or 'totals.grand'. Default 'data'.

config_fields.name: ttl
config_fields.description: Seconds until the entry expires (1-86400). Blank keeps the value until cache_delete or eviction.

config_fields.name: raceConditionTtl
config_fields.description: Extra seconds Rails.cache keeps a stale value during a stampede (1-3600). Leave blank to disable.

config_fields.name: namespace
config_fields.description: Optional literal prefix inserted before the key, e.g. 'reports'. Leave blank for none.

config_fields.name: version
config_fields.description: Optional version token such as 'v2'. A changed version stores beside the old entry.

config_fields.name: tags
config_fields.description: Tag names this key joins, e.g. 'order'. cache_delete with scope 'tagged' invalidates them together.

step_actions.label: Acquire Lock
step_actions.description: Acquires a tenant-scoped Rails.cache lock without waiting, so two submits cannot process the same order at once. Pair with release_lock: this step stores the lock name in lockKeyVar (default _cache_lock_key) and the holder token in tokenVar (default _lock_token). lockKey is a Liquid template such as 'order:{{ model.id }}', or lockKeyVariable a ctx path. ttl (default 30s, max 3600) is how long the lock lives if a later step fails before release_lock runs — put release_lock on the failure track to release early. onConflict 'fail' (default) fails with acquire_lock.lock_busy; 'skip' continues without the lock. Fails with acquire_lock.failed on a blank key or missing tenant.

config_fields.name: lockKey
config_fields.description: Liquid lock name, e.g. 'order:{{ model.id }}'. Use lockKeyVariable instead to read the name from ctx. One of the two is required.

config_fields.name: lockKeyVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path holding the lock name, e.g. 'job_id'. When set, it wins over lockKey.

config_fields.name: holderIdentity
config_fields.description: Holder token written to the lock. Blank generates SecureRandom.hex. A ctx[:name] path is also accepted.

config_fields.name: ttl
config_fields.description: Seconds the lock is held if release_lock never runs (1-3600, default 30). The lock then expires on its own.

config_fields.name: onConflict
config_fields.description: 'fail' (default) fails the step with acquire_lock.lock_busy. 'skip' continues without holding the lock. The step never waits.

config_fields.name: lockKeyVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that stores the lock name for release_lock. Default '_cache_lock_key'.

config_fields.name: tokenVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that stores the holder token for release_lock. Default '_lock_token'.

step_actions.label: Release Lock
step_actions.description: Releases the tenant-scoped lock taken by acquire_lock. When lockKey and lockKeyVariable are blank, reads ctx[:_cache_lock_key]; when holderIdentity is blank, reads ctx[:_lock_token] — matching acquire_lock defaults. Otherwise lockKey is a Liquid template or lockKeyVariable a ctx path, and holderIdentity is the token (or ctx[:name]). onMissing 'ignore' (default) succeeds even if this token does not hold the lock; 'fail' fails with release_lock.not_held; 'log' warns and succeeds. Fails with release_lock.failed on a blank key, blank token, or missing tenant. A lock that is never released expires at the acquire ttl.

config_fields.name: lockKey
config_fields.description: Liquid lock name to release. Leave blank to use ctx[:_cache_lock_key] from acquire_lock. lockKeyVariable wins when set.

config_fields.name: lockKeyVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path holding the lock name, e.g. '_cache_lock_key'. When set, it wins over lockKey and the acquire_lock default.

config_fields.name: holderIdentity
config_fields.description: Holder token that must match the lock. Blank uses ctx[:_lock_token] from acquire_lock. A ctx[:name] path is also accepted.

config_fields.name: onMissing
config_fields.description: 'ignore' (default) succeeds if this token does not hold the lock. 'fail' fails with release_lock.not_held. 'log' warns and succeeds.

step_actions.label: Idempotency Check
step_actions.description: Claims a tenant-scoped Rails.cache key so a double click cannot create two orders. Use rate_limiter to cap volume, not to dedupe one payload. keyStrategy 'ctx_field' (default) uses ctxField.to_s; 'hash_of_inputs' SHA-256-digests ctx[:params]; 'explicit' uses a Liquid explicitKey such as 'order:{{ model.id }}'. scope 'tenant' is unique per customer; 'user' also requires current_user_id. onDuplicate 'fail' (default) fails with duplicate_request; 'skip' continues; 'flag' continues and writes :claimed or :duplicate. ttlSeconds (default 3600) is how long the claim lasts. Fails with idempotency_check.failed on a blank key, and with idempotency_user_required when unsigned.

config_fields.name: keyStrategy
config_fields.description: 'ctx_field' (default) uses ctxField. 'hash_of_inputs' digests ctx[:params]. 'explicit' uses the Liquid explicitKey.

config_fields.name: ctxField
config_fields.description: ctx path whose string value is the idempotency key, e.g. 'params.idempotency_key' or 'order_id'.

config_fields.name: explicitKey
config_fields.description: Liquid idempotency key, e.g. 'order:{{ model.id }}'. Shown when keyStrategy is 'explicit'.

config_fields.name: scope
config_fields.description: 'tenant' (default) is unique per customer. 'user' is unique per signed-in current_user_id and fails when unsigned.

config_fields.name: onDuplicate
config_fields.description: 'fail' (default) stops a duplicate with duplicate_request. 'skip' continues. 'flag' continues and writes :claimed or :duplicate to resultVar.

config_fields.name: ttlSeconds
config_fields.description: Seconds the claimed key stays reserved (1-2592000). Default 3600. A later submit with the same key is a duplicate until then.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that receives :claimed or :duplicate. Default 'idempotency_result'.

step_actions.label: Rate Limiter
step_actions.description: Throttles how often this customer (or user, IP, or custom value) may pass a step, using one atomic cache increment per run. Use idempotency_check to block a duplicate payload. limiterName is a stable label (e.g. 'signup'). capacity (default 100) slots per window seconds (default 60). scope 'global' is one bucket for the customer; 'user' uses current_user_id; 'ip' uses request_ip; 'custom' uses scopeVariable. cost (default 1) is consumed in one increment. onExceed 'fail' (default) fails with rate_limited; 'skip' continues. Writes allowed to resultVar and seconds until reset to retryAfterVar. Fails with rate_limiter.failed on a blank name, bad scope, or missing tenant.

config_fields.name: limiterName
config_fields.description: Stable label for this limiter, e.g. 'signup' or 'checkout'. Tenant-scoped; wildcards are refused.

config_fields.name: capacity
config_fields.description: How many slots the current window admits (1-100000). Default 100.

config_fields.name: window
config_fields.description: Window length in seconds (1-86400). Default 60. The count resets when the next window starts.

config_fields.name: scope
config_fields.description: 'global' (default) is one bucket for the customer. 'user' uses current_user_id. 'ip' uses request_ip. 'custom' uses scopeVariable.

config_fields.name: scopeVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path whose string value further scopes the bucket when scope is 'custom', e.g. 'account_id'.

config_fields.name: cost
config_fields.description: Slots this run consumes in one atomic increment (1-100). Default 1. Use a higher cost for expensive work.

config_fields.name: onExceed
config_fields.description: 'fail' (default) fails with rate_limited when the window is full. 'skip' continues. The step never waits.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable set to true when the run is admitted, false when denied. Default 'throttle_state'.

config_fields.name: retryAfterVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable set to seconds until the window resets when denied, or 0 when admitted. Default 'retry_after_seconds'.

step_actions.label: Business Hours Check
step_actions.description: Evaluates a weekly schedule in an IANA timezone, with optional holiday dates. Use deadline_check for an SLA instant. schedule maps monday..sunday to 'HH:MM-HH:MM'; comma-separate two windows for a lunch break ('09:00-12:00,13:00-17:00'). Reads timeVariable or Time.current. resultMode 'bool' writes open? to resultVar; 'next_open' writes the next opening Time; 'minutes_until_open' writes minutes until then; 'add_business_minutes' adds businessMinutes of open time. Omit a weekday to close it. Fails with business_hours_check.failed on a bad timezone, holiday, or when added minutes exceed the horizon.

config_fields.name: schedule
config_fields.description: Weekday (monday..sunday) to 'HH:MM-HH:MM'. Lunch break: '09:00-12:00,13:00-17:00'. Omit a day to close it.

config_fields.name: holidays
config_fields.description: Closed dates as YYYY-MM-DD keys (value is a label). Example key '2026-12-25'.

config_fields.name: timezone
config_fields.description: IANA timezone used to evaluate the schedule, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Default 'UTC'.

config_fields.name: timeVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path holding a Time or ISO8601 string. Blank uses Time.current.

config_fields.name: resultMode
config_fields.description: 'bool' writes open?. 'next_open' writes the next opening Time. 'minutes_until_open' writes minutes until then. 'add_business_minutes' adds businessMinutes.

config_fields.name: businessMinutes
config_fields.description: Open minutes to add to the start time when resultMode is add_business_minutes (0-525600).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that receives the check result. Default 'hours_status'.

step_actions.label: Deadline Check
step_actions.description: Compares a deadline in ctx against a clock for SLA handling (due dates, booking cutoffs). Use business_hours_check for weekly opening hours. Reads deadlineVariable (Time or string; deadlineFormat iso8601/rfc2822/auto). Optional referenceTime (blank = now), gracePeriodSeconds, and warningSeconds. Writes {passed, remaining_seconds, overdue_seconds} to resultVar, a boolean to breachedVar, and a boolean to atRiskVar. behaviorOnBreach 'mark' (default) always succeeds; 'fail' fails with deadline_check.breached when the grace window has passed. Fails with deadline_check.failed when the deadline cannot be parsed.

config_fields.name: deadlineVariable
config_fields.description: ctx path holding the deadline as a Time, Date, or string, e.g. 'due_at'. Default 'deadline'.

config_fields.name: deadlineFormat
config_fields.description: 'auto' (default) uses Time.parse. 'iso8601' and 'rfc2822' require that string shape. Ignored when the value is already a Time.

config_fields.name: referenceTime
config_fields.description: ctx path for the clock, e.g. 'now'. Blank uses Time.current.

config_fields.name: gracePeriodSeconds
config_fields.description: Seconds added to the deadline before breachedVar is true (0-31536000). Default 0.

config_fields.name: warningSeconds
config_fields.description: When remaining seconds are at or below this (and not breached), atRiskVar is true. 0 disables. Default 0.

config_fields.name: behaviorOnBreach
config_fields.description: 'mark' (default) writes flags and succeeds. 'fail' also fails the step with deadline_check.breached when the grace window has passed.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable that receives {passed, remaining_seconds, overdue_seconds}. Default 'deadline_status'.

config_fields.name: breachedVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable set to true when now is after deadline + grace. Default 'deadline_breached'.

config_fields.name: atRiskVar
config_fields.description: ctx variable set to true when remaining time is within warningSeconds. Default 'deadline_at_risk'.

step_actions.label: Next Occurrence
step_actions.description: Computes the next run, renewal, or due instant from a calendar or cron recurrence in a named timezone (blank uses Time.zone). Reads optional startVariable, fromVariable, and untilVariable. Writes resultVar as one Time or a list. Use date_time_calc to add a one-off duration. Fails with next_occurrence.invalid_anchor when a bound is unparseable and next_occurrence.no_occurrence when nothing falls after from.

config_fields.name: frequency
config_fields.description: How the series repeats: daily, weekly (weekdays), monthly and yearly (dayOfMonth), or cron.

config_fields.name: interval
config_fields.description: Repeat every N periods (1-366). Example: 2 with monthly is every other month. Unused for cron.

config_fields.name: startVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the series anchor (e.g. params.starts_on). Blank uses Time.current in timezone.

config_fields.name: fromVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the time occurrences must be strictly after. Blank uses Time.current.

config_fields.name: weekdays
config_fields.description: Weekdays as mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun. Blank uses the start weekday. Example: mon and thu.

config_fields.name: dayOfMonth
config_fields.description: Day of month: 0 uses the start day, -1 the last day, 1-31 a fixed day. Combined with monthEndPolicy.

config_fields.name: monthEndPolicy
config_fields.description: When the month is shorter than dayOfMonth: clamp uses the last day (28 Feb); skip omits that month.

config_fields.name: cronExpression
config_fields.description: Five- or six-field cron used when frequency is cron. Example: 0 9 * * * for 09:00 every day.

config_fields.name: timeOfDay
config_fields.description: HH:MM applied to calendar occurrences (e.g. 09:30). Blank keeps the start time of day.

config_fields.name: timezone
config_fields.description: IANA timezone for the series (e.g. Asia/Shanghai). Blank uses Time.zone.

config_fields.name: businessDayAdjust
config_fields.description: Weekend handling: none keeps Saturday/Sunday; next_business_day and previous_business_day shift to a weekday.

config_fields.name: returns
config_fields.description: first writes the next instant; list writes up to count upcoming instants.

config_fields.name: count
config_fields.description: How many occurrences to return when returns is list (1-366). Default 5.

config_fields.name: untilVariable
config_fields.description: Context path of the exclusive end of the series. Occurrences after this time are omitted.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Context variable that receives the next Time, or an array of Times when returns is list.

step_actions.label: Refund payment
step_actions.description: Refunds a captured payment of this customer through Payments::Activities::Refund, scoped to ctx[:customer_id]. Use partial with amount for a part of the remaining captured total, or full to refund everything still captured. Use request_payment to take money, not this step. Reads payment (id or Payment record) and optional amount/reason. Writes the Payments::Refund record to resultVar. Refuses refund_payment.not_found, not_captured, non_positive, exceeds_remainder, billing_collection, or failed. Never refunds another tenant's payment.

config_fields.name: payment
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for a payment id of this customer, or a Payments::Payment record already loaded, such as ctx[:payment_id]. Looked up with Payments::Payment.for_customer; another tenant's id is not_found.

config_fields.name: refundMode
config_fields.description: partial (default) refunds amount, which must be a positive decimal in major units and not more than the remaining captured total. full refunds the entire remaining captured amount and ignores amount.

config_fields.name: amount
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the refund amount in major units when refundMode is partial, such as BigDecimal("1.00") or ctx[:refund_amount]. Do not use a Float literal (1.00). Required for partial; omitted for full.

config_fields.name: reason
config_fields.description: Optional Ruby expression for the reason recorded with the refund, such as "duplicate" or ctx[:reason]. Stored on the refund row and sent to the gateway when it supports a reason.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the Payments::Refund record after a successful refund, such as refund. Unset when the step refuses.

step_actions.label: Request payment
step_actions.description: Hands off to checkout after the submission, which creates the payment order. Put this after everything it charges for is saved. amount is the saved total (ctx[:model].total); currency is ISO 4217 (CNY). paidRecord is the record paid for (blank for the page record); paidFields are set on it once payment succeeds, each value one of that field's options. Use refund_payment to give money back and set_submission_outcome for flash copy (it preserves this handoff). Parks the handoff on ctx[:submission_outcome]. Refuses invalid_order, module_disabled, invalid_paid_record, or invalid_paid_field.

config_fields.name: amount
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the order amount in major units, such as ctx[:model].total or ctx[:pricing]["total"]. Use a decimal string or BigDecimal, not a Float literal (10.00). Must be positive after currency rounding (CNY 2 decimals).

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code as three uppercase letters, such as CNY. Checkout currently charges in CNY. Do not write a Ruby expression here.

config_fields.name: subject
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the order subject shown at checkout, such as "Registration fee" or "Payment " + ctx[:model].reference_number.to_s. Must evaluate to a non-blank string.

config_fields.name: description
config_fields.description: Optional Ruby expression for a payer note stored on the order as body, such as "Payer note" or ctx[:model].note. Leave blank to omit.

config_fields.name: paidRecord
config_fields.description: Ruby expression for the saved EntityEntry this payment is for, such as ctx[:referenced_record]. Leave blank for the page's own record (ctx[:model]). Must already be persisted for this customer.

config_fields.name: paidFields
config_fields.description: Fields set on the record paid for once payment succeeds. Each key is a writable slug (status) and each value is stored as typed, exactly one of that field's options when the field is a select (Paid). Nothing is written until payment succeeds; never also set those fields with update_model.

config_fields.name: paidAtField
config_fields.description: Optional date or time field slug on the record paid for that receives the payment time, such as paid_on. Leave blank to skip. Must be a writable stored field, not calculated.

config_fields.name: paymentReferenceField
config_fields.description: Optional text field slug on the record paid for that receives the payment reference, such as payment_reference. Leave blank to skip. Must be a writable stored field.

config_fields.name: metadata
config_fields.description: Optional key/value pairs stored on the order. Each key is a name (sku) and each value is a Ruby expression over ctx ("abc" or ctx[:sku]).

config_fields.name: expiresInMinutes
config_fields.description: Minutes until the checkout order expires, from 1 to 10080 (7 days). Leave blank for no expiry. Converted to an UTC expires_at timestamp at run time.

config_fields.name: exitKind
config_fields.description: Where to send the visitor when checkout finishes. none uses the default landing. page opens exitPage. url opens exitUrl. route opens exitRoute. record opens the record paid for (requires that record to be saved).

config_fields.name: exitPage
config_fields.description: Launched page of this customer to open when checkout finishes. Required when exitKind is page.

config_fields.name: exitUrl
config_fields.description: http or https URL to open when checkout finishes, such as https://example.test. javascript: and other schemes are rejected.

config_fields.name: exitRoute
config_fields.description: Named Rails route to open when checkout finishes, such as customer_home. Required when exitKind is route.

step_actions.label: Hand off to module
step_actions.description: Sends the visitor to a FeatureModules handoff after the submission saves, parking { module_key, input, exit_target } on ctx[:submission_outcome] handoff. Use request_payment for a payment checkout (it is the payment-specific handoff). Use set_submission_outcome for flash copy; it preserves an existing handoff. Reads moduleKey and input expressions. Does not create the module's records here. Refuses hand_off_to_module.module_unavailable when the module is off or has no handoff for this customer.

config_fields.name: moduleKey
config_fields.description: Key of a handoff-enabled module this customer has turned on, such as payment. Checked at run time against FeatureModules for ctx[:customer_id].

config_fields.name: input
config_fields.description: Inputs passed to the module. Each key is one of the module's input fields (amount) and each value is a Ruby expression over ctx (ctx[:model].fee). Unsafe or blank rows are dropped.

config_fields.name: exitKind
config_fields.description: Where to send the visitor when the module finishes. none (default) uses the module's landing. page opens exitPage. url opens exitUrl (http/https only). route opens the named exitRoute.

config_fields.name: exitPage
config_fields.description: Launched page of this customer to open when the module finishes. Required when exitKind is page.

config_fields.name: exitUrl
config_fields.description: http or https URL to open when the module finishes, such as https://example.test. javascript: and other schemes are rejected.

config_fields.name: exitRoute
config_fields.description: Named Rails route to open when the module finishes, such as customer_home. Required when exitKind is route.

step_actions.label: Set submission outcome
step_actions.description: Sets the public flash after a successful submit: preset copy (submitted, saved, thank_you) or a custom localized message, with notice or alert styling. This step does not choose a destination; use hand_off_to_module or request_payment (and their exitKind) to send the visitor somewhere, and skip_journey_steps to leave later journey steps out. Those writes live on ctx[:submission_outcome] and this step preserves handoff and journey keys already parked there, so run it before or after them without clobbering. Writes ctx[:submission_outcome] preset, message, and flash.

config_fields.name: preset
config_fields.description: Standard thank-you copy shown after submit: submitted, saved, or thank_you. custom uses the localized message field instead (required when custom).

config_fields.name: message
config_fields.description: Localized flash text. Required when preset is custom; optional extra copy for the other presets. Hash of locale to text. Named placeholders such as %{name} are filled from messageVariables.

config_fields.name: flash
config_fields.description: Banner style shown after a successful submit. notice is the default success banner; alert is a warning-style banner.

config_fields.name: messageVariables
config_fields.description: Named placeholders interpolated into message. Each key is a placeholder name (name) and each value is a Ruby expression over ctx (ctx[:name]). Applied to every locale of the stored message.

step_actions.label: Skip journey steps
step_actions.description: Leaves later steps of the visitor's current journey out by parking their keys on ctx[:submission_outcome] journey skip, which Journeys::Advance applies after a successful submit. Put this after save_model behind a decision (for example skip catering when the booking is not catering). Only steps the journey marks as skippable are left out, and so are steps that need their records. Use set_submission_outcome for flash copy and hand_off_to_module or request_payment for a destination. Reads the steps list. Does nothing when ctx[:journey] is missing. Invalid keys are rejected at design time.

config_fields.name: steps
config_fields.description: Keys of later journey steps to leave out, such as catering. Each key is lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores matching Journeys::Definition::KEY. Only steps the journey lets processing skip are actually skipped.

step_actions.label: Invoke Service
step_actions.description: Calls an allow-listed application service as Service.call(**kwargs) and stores the return value on resultVar (default service_result). Use this for a domain service such as a payment write-back or module caster; use send_email, request_payment, or the HTTP actions for those jobs. Keyword values are ctx paths (order.total) or literals. passContext adds ctx: ctx. A Result with ok or success? false copies its errors onto the submitter and fails the step; Invocable and argument errors fail as invoke_service.failed. False or nil returns stay on resultVar and the step succeeds.

config_fields.name: serviceClass
config_fields.description: Allow-listed Ruby class that defines self.call(**kwargs) under app/, such as FeatureModules::InputCaster or Payments::HandoffCompletion. ActiveRecord models and classes without call are rejected.

config_fields.name: kwargs
config_fields.description: Keyword arguments for call. Each key is a Ruby keyword (input, customer). Each value is a ctx path (order.total) or a literal (true, 2, queued).

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the return value, including a failed Result object. Default service_result. Later steps read this name.

config_fields.name: passContext
config_fields.description: When true, also pass ctx: ctx so the service can read tenant and request keys. The service must accept that keyword. Default false.

step_actions.label: AI Inference
step_actions.description: Runs one chat completion through the platform generation provider (AiAssistant::ProviderSettings.active_for(:generation) via Llm) and stores the answer on resultVar (default ai_response). Use this to summarise or extract fields from a submit, not for the admin assistant. promptTemplate and systemPrompt are Liquid over ctx ({{ text }}). Blank model uses the provider chat_model. text stores a string; json and structured parse JSON (jsonRepair strips fences; onInvalidJson as_text keeps the raw string). Fails as not_configured when no provider is active, unsupported_provider for Cursor, empty when the model returns blank, and failed on transport errors.

config_fields.name: promptTemplate
config_fields.description: Liquid user prompt interpolated from ctx, such as Summarize: {{ text }}. Required. Keep it short; the platform model fills the completion.

config_fields.name: systemPrompt
config_fields.description: Optional Liquid system instructions interpolated from ctx, such as You are a clerk for {{ org_name }}. Leave blank for none.

config_fields.name: model
config_fields.description: Optional chat-model id that overrides the provider chat_model, such as deepseek-chat or qwen-plus. Leave blank to use the platform setting.

config_fields.name: maxTokens
config_fields.description: Maximum tokens requested from the provider (1-128000). Default 1024.

config_fields.name: temperature
config_fields.description: Sampling temperature from 0 (deterministic) to 2. Default 0.7.

config_fields.name: outputFormat
config_fields.description: How the answer is stored. text keeps the string. json parses JSON into a Hash (onInvalidJson can keep the string). structured also parses JSON and always fails when it is invalid. json and structured ask the model for JSON.

config_fields.name: jsonRepair
config_fields.description: When true, strip markdown fences (```json ... ```) before JSON.parse. Default false. Shown for json and structured.

config_fields.name: onInvalidJson
config_fields.description: When JSON.parse fails for outputFormat json: fail refuses the step; as_text stores the raw model text and continues. Default fail. Hidden for structured.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the string or parsed Hash. Default ai_response.

step_actions.label: Audit Log
step_actions.description: Writes one structured audit line and a tenant-scoped flowchart_audit_events row for this submit (rolled back with the submit). Use this after an approval, payment, or record change; use log for operator-only debug text. eventType is required (order.approved). Blank actor, resource, IP, and user-agent fall back to ctx current_user_id, model, request_ip, and user_agent. metadata is extra ctx pairs; changesVariable copies a diff hash. severity (info default) picks the logger method; outcome success|failure is stored on metadata. Always succeeds unless persistence raises.

config_fields.name: eventType
config_fields.description: Stable event name written on the row and log line, such as record_updated or order.approved. Required. Prefer dotted past-tense names.

config_fields.name: resourceType
config_fields.description: Type label for the resource, such as Order. Leave blank to use the bound model entity name when ctx[:model] is set.

config_fields.name: resourceId
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the resource id, such as order.id. Leave blank to use ctx[:model].id when a record is loaded.

config_fields.name: actorId
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the actor id. Default current_user_id. Leave blank to use that same seeded key at runtime.

config_fields.name: actorType
config_fields.description: Actor kind, such as User or System. Leave blank to store User when an actor id is present.

config_fields.name: metadata
config_fields.description: Extra key/value pairs on the event. Each value is a ctx path (sku or order.number). outcome and changes are added separately.

config_fields.name: ipAddress
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the client IP. Default request_ip. Leave blank to use that seeded key.

config_fields.name: userAgent
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the client user agent. Default user_agent. Leave blank to use that seeded key.

config_fields.name: severity
config_fields.description: Log severity stored on the row: debug, info (default), warn, error, or critical (logged as error). Pick warn or error for refused submits.

config_fields.name: outcome
config_fields.description: Recorded on metadata.outcome. success (default) for a completed action; failure when this step audits a refused path.

config_fields.name: changesVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of a diff hash stored under metadata.changes, such as record_diff from compare_data. Leave blank to omit.

step_actions.label: Barcode Generate
step_actions.description: Encodes sourceVariable (a SKU, ticket id, or URL) as a barcode or QR image and stores a hash on resultVar (default barcode_image) with bytes, content_type, filename, and data_uri for send_email HTML (img src) or template_render. format code128 (default) suits labels; ean13 needs a 12-digit payload plus check digit; qr encodes a URL or ticket. outputFormat png (default) or svg; svg can draw a human-readable line. Fails as barcode_generate.failed on empty or invalid payload (for example a non-numeric EAN).

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the payload to encode, such as sku, ticket_number, or checkout_url. Required. Empty values fail the step.

config_fields.name: format
config_fields.description: Symbology. code128 (default) for SKUs and labels. ean13 / ean8 / upca for retail GTINs. code39, itf, and codabar for warehouse codes. qr for a URL or ticket payload.

config_fields.name: width
config_fields.description: Module width in pixels for 1D barcodes (1-32). Default 2. Hidden for qr.

config_fields.name: height
config_fields.description: Bar height in pixels for 1D barcodes (1-1000). Default 100. Hidden for qr.

config_fields.name: margin
config_fields.description: Quiet zone in pixels (1D) or modules (qr). Default 10. Use 0-100.

config_fields.name: outputFormat
config_fields.description: Image encoding. png (default) for PDF and email data_uri. svg for HTML and labels. jpg when a JPEG blob is required. base64 is a PNG string. ascii is QR text art only.

config_fields.name: includeText
config_fields.description: When true (default), draw the payload under an SVG 1D barcode. Hidden unless outputFormat is svg. Ignored for qr.

config_fields.name: textFont
config_fields.description: Font for the SVG human-readable line: Helvetica (default), Arial, DejaVuSans, or FreeSans. Hidden unless outputFormat is svg.

config_fields.name: size
config_fields.description: QR module size in pixels (1-40). Default 4. Hidden unless format is qr.

config_fields.name: errorCorrection
config_fields.description: QR error-correction level: L (~7%), M (default, ~15%), Q (~25%), H (~30%). Hidden unless format is qr.

config_fields.name: colorDark
config_fields.description: QR dark-module colour as #RGB, #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA. Default #000000. Hidden unless format is qr.

config_fields.name: colorLight
config_fields.description: QR light-module colour as #RGB, #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA. Default #FFFFFF. Hidden unless format is qr.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable for the artifact hash (bytes, content_type, filename, data_uri). Default barcode_image. Use data_uri in an email img src.

step_actions.label: Currency Convert
step_actions.description: Converts amount from fromCurrency to toCurrency with BigDecimal rounding and stores a fixed-scale decimal string on resultVar (default converted). Use this for checkout totals, refunds, and invoices; do not call an external rate API (none is configured). rateSource fixed (default) uses fixedRate (1 USD = 0.92 EUR). ctx reads a rates hash from ratesVariable (pair USD_EUR, a to-code, or a base table for a cross rate). config uses staticRates. fromCurrencyFrom / toCurrencyFrom override the ISO codes from ctx. onMissingRate fail refuses; identity keeps the original amount. Same-currency copies the rounded amount.

config_fields.name: amount
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the amount to convert, such as price or order.total. Required. Parsed with BigDecimal; blank or non-numeric values fail.

config_fields.name: fromCurrency
config_fields.description: Source ISO-4217 code (three letters), such as USD. Default USD. Ignored when fromCurrencyFrom is set.

config_fields.name: toCurrency
config_fields.description: Target ISO-4217 code (three letters), such as EUR. Required. Ignored when toCurrencyFrom is set.

config_fields.name: rateSource
config_fields.description: Where the rate comes from. fixed (default) uses fixedRate. ctx reads ratesVariable. config uses the staticRates table. No HTTP fetch.

config_fields.name: fixedRate
config_fields.description: Multiplier when rateSource is fixed, such as 0.92 for 1 USD to EUR. Required for fixed. Must be zero or greater.

config_fields.name: rounding
config_fields.description: BigDecimal rounding: half_up (default), half_even (banker's), floor, or ceiling. Applied after multiplying by the rate.

config_fields.name: precision
config_fields.description: Decimal places kept on the result string (0-12). Default 2 for most currencies. Use 0 for zero-decimal currencies such as JPY.

config_fields.name: ratesVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of a rates hash when rateSource is ctx. Default exchange_rates. Keys may be USD_EUR, EUR (rate from fromCurrency), or a base table for a cross rate.

config_fields.name: staticRates
config_fields.description: Inline rate table when rateSource is config. Keys are ISO codes or pairs (USD_EUR); values are multipliers such as 0.92.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable for the rounded decimal string, such as 9.20. Default converted.

config_fields.name: fromCurrencyFrom
config_fields.description: Ctx path that overrides fromCurrency when set, such as order.currency. Leave blank to use the From Currency literal.

config_fields.name: toCurrencyFrom
config_fields.description: Ctx path that overrides toCurrency when set, such as display_currency. Leave blank to use the To Currency literal.

config_fields.name: onMissingRate
config_fields.description: When the table has no rate: fail (default) refuses the step; identity stores the original amount rounded to precision.

step_actions.label: Geolocation Lookup
step_actions.description: Calculates Haversine distance between two coordinates and stores { km, miles } on resultVar (default location). Use this for delivery radius, event proximity, or pickup distance. sourceVariable and otherVariable are hashes or entity rows with lat/latitude and lng/lon/longitude. The platform does not configure Google Maps or Mapbox, so this action does not geocode an IP or address; put coordinates on the record first. Fails as geolocation_lookup.invalid_coordinates when a point is missing, and failed on unexpected errors.

config_fields.name: sourceVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the origin point, such as origin or venue. A hash or entity row with lat/latitude and lng/lon/longitude. Required.

config_fields.name: otherVariable
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the destination point, such as destination or member_location. Same shape as sourceVariable. Required.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable for the result hash { km:, miles: } with four decimal places. Default location. Read location.km in a later Decision.

step_actions.label: I18n Translate
step_actions.description: Looks up a catalog translation key with I18n.t and stores the string on resultVar (default translated). Use this for flash copy, email subjects, and pluralised labels that live in locale files; use template_render (Liquid) to compose a freeform body, and a template field on send_email for a single interpolated string. key is required (greeting.hello). locale or localeFrom selects the language; blank uses the request locale. interpolations bind ctx paths into %{name} tokens. default / fallbackLocale cover a missing key; raiseOnMissing fails as i18n_translate.failed.

config_fields.name: key
config_fields.description: I18n key to look up, such as greeting.hello or notifications.new_order. Required. Dot notation; do not include a locale prefix.

config_fields.name: locale
config_fields.description: Locale id such as en or zh-CN. Leave blank for the request locale. Ignored when localeFrom is set.

config_fields.name: localeFrom
config_fields.description: Ctx path of a locale that overrides Locale, such as visitor_locale. Leave blank to use the Locale literal or the request locale.

config_fields.name: fallbackLocale
config_fields.description: Locale tried when the primary lookup is missing, such as en. Leave blank to skip a second lookup.

config_fields.name: interpolations
config_fields.description: Values for %{name} tokens. Each key is an interpolation name (name, count); each value is a ctx path (person.name) or a literal.

config_fields.name: scope
config_fields.description: Optional I18n scope prepended to key, such as activerecord.models. Leave blank when key is already fully qualified.

config_fields.name: default
config_fields.description: Fallback text when the key is missing and raiseOnMissing is false, such as Hello. Leave blank to let I18n emit its missing-translation string.

config_fields.name: count
config_fields.description: Ctx path of the pluralisation count, such as items_count. Leave blank when the translation has no one/other forms.

config_fields.name: raiseOnMissing
config_fields.description: When true, fail the step as i18n_translate.failed if the key (and fallback) are missing. Default false.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the translated string. Default translated.

step_actions.label: Template Render
step_actions.description: Renders a Liquid template over the run ctx (plus optional variables) and stores the string on resultVar (default rendered). Use this to compose a receipt, SMS, or HTML snippet from submit data; use i18n_translate for a catalog key, and a template field on send_email or generate_document when that action interpolates one string itself. {{ name }} reads ctx[:name]. outputFormat html escapes interpolated values. strictVariables fails as template_render.failed when a referenced name is missing; trimWhitespace strips the result.

config_fields.name: template
config_fields.description: Liquid template body, such as Hello {{ name }} or Order {{ model.number }}. Required. Ctx keys are already in scope; do not wrap in extra quotes.

config_fields.name: variables
config_fields.description: Extra bindings merged over ctx. Each key is a Liquid name (name); each value is a ctx path (person) or a literal. Overrides a same-named ctx key.

config_fields.name: strictVariables
config_fields.description: When true, fail the step as template_render.failed if the template names a missing variable. Default false (missing names render empty).

config_fields.name: outputFormat
config_fields.description: text (default) keeps interpolated values as-is. html HTML-escapes them before insert, for a snippet you later put in send_email.

config_fields.name: trimWhitespace
config_fields.description: When true, strip leading and trailing whitespace from the rendered string. Default false.

config_fields.name: resultVar
config_fields.description: Ctx variable that receives the rendered string. Default rendered. Point send_email body at this name when you compose HTML first.

element_types.description: Entry point. Exactly one per flowchart, with no incoming connections; every other element must be reachable from it. No config fields: the run's seeded variables (params, bound_entity, customer_id, current_user_id, audience, locale) are already in ctx when it starts.

Exit point. At least one per flowchart, with no outgoing connections. Reaching any End finishes the run successfully; to refuse, use a failing step instead. responseType value writes returnValue to ctx[:response] for a parent that runs this flowchart as a subflow; a page flowchart needs none.

config_fields.name: responseType
config_fields.description: none ends with no result. value writes returnValue to ctx[:response] for the parent flowchart that runs this one as a subflow.

config_fields.name: returnValue
config_fields.description: Result written to ctx[:response]: a ctx path such as ctx.order.total or any Ruby expression such as ctx[:total] * 2. Quote text: "approved".

element_types.description: Ordered container of step actions; put the business logic here. Steps run top to bottom, each reading what earlier steps wrote to ctx, and the first step that fails refuses the submission with its message. Each step names a registered palette action and MUST include a config object using that action's config_fields.

properties.label: Display label
properties.steps: Array of { action (canonical ActionCatalog key), config (required object of declared fields), selectionLabels (optional) }

element_types.description: Routes to one of >= 2 outgoing connections, listed in branch order; it never writes variables or refuses. Each connection carries label and matchValue; blank matchValue = Otherwise (at most one). routeBy value: matchValue is compared with subject, values unique. routeBy condition: matchValue "true" (Yes, required), "false" (No) or blank. Every conditions field is a flat group {type: "group", joins: ["AND"|"OR" per gap], conditions: [{kind: "field", leftOperand, operator, rightOperand}]}.

config_fields.name: routeBy
config_fields.description: condition takes the connection whose matchValue is "true" when the condition holds, else "false" or the blank Otherwise. value takes the connection whose matchValue equals subject as text.

config_fields.name: subject
config_fields.description: Value compared as text with each connection's matchValue, such as ctx[:model].status or ctx[:params][:plan]; no match takes the blank Otherwise.

config_fields.name: condition
config_fields.description: Yes/No test; leftOperand is a ctx path such as ctx.model.status and rightOperand a literal or another ctx path.

element_types.description: Repeats its body. It has exactly two outgoing connections: one into the body, whose last element connects back to the loop, and one exit followed when the loop finishes. while: runs while condition holds (runOnceFirst checks after the first pass). for_each: walks collection, a ctx path without the ctx. prefix, binding itemVariable and indexVariable for the body. Loops do not nest. Reaching maxIterations fails the run.

config_fields.name: loopType
config_fields.description: while repeats as long as condition holds. for_each runs the body once per item of collection.

config_fields.name: runOnceFirst
config_fields.description: Run the body once before condition is first checked (do-while).

config_fields.name: condition
config_fields.description: Checked before every pass; the loop exits through Done as soon as it is false.

config_fields.name: collection
config_fields.description: Path of the list to walk, without the ctx. prefix, such as order_lines or model.items; a missing value counts as an empty list.

config_fields.name: itemVariable
config_fields.description: Variable holding the current item during each pass (ctx[:item]).

config_fields.name: maxIterations
config_fields.description: Safety cap on passes; reaching it refuses the run. Set it above the largest list or retry count you expect.

config_fields.name: stopWhen
config_fields.description: Checked at the start of each pass (for_each: once the item is bound); when true the loop exits early through Done.

config_fields.name: skipWhen
config_fields.description: Items for which this holds are skipped without running the body and are not collected.

config_fields.name: indexVariable
config_fields.description: Variable holding the zero-based position of the current item (ctx[:index]).

config_fields.name: collectInto
config_fields.description: Optional list variable that gathers every item the body ran for, such as the lines that were not skipped.

element_types.description: Runs another launched flowchart (flowchartId) as one step. The child sees this run's variables plus any inputVariables, and what it writes comes back under the same names; when the child refuses, this run refuses with its messages. One outgoing connection.

config_fields.name: flowchartId
config_fields.description: Id of the launched flowchart to run. It must belong to the same customer or be shared, and must not lead back to this flowchart.

config_fields.name: inputVariables
config_fields.description: Named inputs the child reads: key is the variable name inside the child (ctx[:key]), value is an expression in this flowchart. Inputs exist only while the child runs; leave empty when the names already match.

connection.description: Directed arrow {from, to} between element ids; the run follows it when the source element succeeds. Only a decision has several outgoing connections: each carries matchValue (and a label), listed in branch order. A step that refuses the submission leaves the happy path on its own, so never draw failure arrows.

config_fields.name: label
config_fields.description: Text shown on the arrow. On a Decision branch it names the outcome (Yes, No, Approved).

config_fields.name: description
config_fields.description: Optional notes for people reading the flowchart; never affects the run.
